How to choose a good IPTV provider in Canada
If you are comparing IPTV providers and IPTV services in Canada, start with five checks: can you test it first, are the prices published, is there a refund policy, does it work on your devices, and can you reach support when something breaks. Prime IPTV is a Canadian-focused IPTV subscription service, built for IPTV in Canada rather than a generic worldwide list, and it covers all five: a 24-hour free trial with no credit card , plans from $34.99 CAD , a 7-day money-back guarantee , support for Firestick, Smart TV, Android TV, Apple TV, phones and MAG boxes, and 24/7 help on WhatsApp. Our best IPTV Canada page explains why Prime IPTV wins on all five, and the IPTV cost guide explains the real monthly price.

IPTV for Canada
Made for Canadian viewers, from coast to coast
Prime IPTV streams over the internet, so it does not depend on a local cable or satellite network. If your home or cottage has a stable connection, you can watch, whether you are in a Toronto condo, a Calgary house or a small town in the Maritimes.
As a rough guide you need about 5 Mbps for SD, 10 for HD, 15 for FHD and 25 or more for 4K, per screen. Check the details in our availability and speed guide .

Good to know
Is IPTV legal in Canada?
IPTV is a delivery technology, and the technology itself is not the issue. What matters is whether the content you watch is properly licensed where you live. Rules differ by country and change over time, so check what applies to you. Viewers are responsible for making sure their use of the service complies with the laws and regulations that apply to them. Read our terms , privacy policy and refund policy before you subscribe.

FAQ
Prime IPTV: your questions answered
What is IPTV? IPTV, short for Internet Protocol Television, is TV that arrives over your internet connection instead of through cable, satellite or an antenna. You open a player app on your device and sign in with the login details from a provider like Prime IPTV.
Is Prime IPTV a player app? No. Prime IPTV (primeiptv4k.ca) is an IPTV subscription service with live TV, sports and on-demand content for viewers in Canada. Some player apps in app stores have similar names, but they are separate products. To watch Prime IPTV you add your login to a compatible IPTV player.
What is Prime IPTV? Prime IPTV is an IPTV subscription service for viewers in Canada, and it is available worldwide too. It includes 25,000+ live channels, 120,000+ movies and series, a TV guide (EPG), sports and PPV, in SD, HD, FHD and 4K.
Does Prime IPTV work in Canada? Yes. Prime IPTV is built for viewers in Canada and works in every province and territory, from Toronto and Montreal to Vancouver, Calgary and Halifax. All you need is a compatible device, a player app and a stable internet connection from any Canadian provider.
Which Canadian provinces does Prime IPTV cover? All of them: Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island, and the three territories. IPTV streams over the internet, so coverage depends on your connection, not on a local cable or satellite network.
How many channels does Prime IPTV offer? More than 25,000 live TV channels, covering entertainment, sports, news, kids and family, and international programming.
How many movies and series are available? The on-demand (VOD) library has more than 120,000 movies and series.
How much does Prime IPTV cost? Plans start at $34.99 CAD for 3 months with 1 connection. You can choose 1, 2, 3 or 4 connections and 3, 6, 12 or 24 months. The 6- and 12-month plans include +1 month free, and the 24-month plans include +2 months free.
Is there a free trial, and do I need a credit card? Yes, there is a 24-hour free trial, and it does not need a credit card.
How do I buy a plan? Pick a plan and press Buy Now! WhatsApp opens with your plan and price already in the message. You pay by credit or debit card, and we send your login by email or WhatsApp.
How quickly will I get my login? Activation is normally within a few minutes after payment. Your login arrives by email or WhatsApp.
What devices can I use? Prime IPTV works with compatible IPTV players on Smart TVs, Fire TV and Firestick, Android TV, Apple TV, Roku, phones, tablets, computers and MAG boxes. Every device has its own step-by-step guide.
Do I need a special box? No. Most people use something they already own, such as a Smart TV, a Firestick or a phone, together with a compatible player app.
What is the difference between an IPTV service and an IPTV player? The service provides the channels and your login. The player only displays them and has no channels of its own. Prime IPTV is the service, and you watch it through a compatible player.
Does Prime IPTV support 4K? Yes, for compatible content and devices. SD, HD and FHD are supported as well.
What internet speed do I need? As a rough guide, you need about 5 Mbps for SD, 10 Mbps for HD, 15 Mbps for FHD and 25 Mbps or more for 4K, per screen. Multiply that by the number of screens streaming at the same time.
Do you offer more than 4 devices? Yes. Standard plans cover 1 to 4 devices (connections). If you need more than 4 devices, message us on WhatsApp or email us and we will quote a plan for you.
How many connections do I need? A connection is one stream playing at a time. Count the most screens that might play together. Plans cover 1 to 4 connections.
Does Prime IPTV include a TV guide and catch-up? A TV guide (EPG) is included. Catch-up depends on the IPTV player you use.
Does Prime IPTV offer sports and PPV? Yes. Prime IPTV includes sports across all major sports packages, plus PPV events where available.
Is there a contract, and can I cancel? There is no contract. Cancellation is available.
Is there a money-back guarantee? Yes. Subscriptions come with a 7-day money-back guarantee. The refund policy explains how to ask for one.
Is support available 24/7? Yes. Support is available 24/7 by WhatsApp and email.
Is Prime IPTV available outside Canada? Prime IPTV serves viewers across Canada and is available worldwide as well.
Which channels and countries are included? All Canadian and US channels and channels from other countries, including sports channels, plus all PPV channels in 4K and FHD.
Does Prime IPTV have Canadian sports and PPV in 4K? Yes. Canadian sports are included along with US sports and sports from other countries, and all PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD.
Which players work with Prime IPTV? Any player that accepts Xtream Codes or an M3U link works, for example IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV. MAC-address players load the playlist against your device’s MAC address.
How do I set up a MAG box? Message us on WhatsApp with your MAG box MAC address. We activate your subscription and send you your portal links.
How is the free trial delivered? We send your 24-hour free trial details by WhatsApp or email. No credit card is needed.
What should I do if a channel buffers or will not load? Check your internet speed, use a wired connection if you can, and restart your player and router. Re-enter your login carefully too. If it still fails, contact support and tell us your device, player, channel and the time it happened.

What is 4K IPTV? Why Prime IPTV wins 4K IPTV provider 4K IPTV box 4K live IPTV 4K IPTV price 4K IPTV is IPTV delivered in 4K (Ultra HD) quality. To watch it you need a 4K TV, a device and player that can play 4K, and a stable connection of about 25 Mbps or more per 4K stream. Prime IPTV streams in SD, HD, FHD and 4K where the content supports it, and all PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD. This guide explains what you need for 4K IPTV in Canada and how to get a smooth picture.
What is 4K IPTV?
4K, also called Ultra HD or UHD, is 3840 &times; 2160 pixels, which is four times the pixels of Full HD (1920 &times; 1080). With IPTV, &ldquo;4K IPTV&rdquo; means the channel or movie you stream is delivered at that resolution. Not every channel or title is produced in 4K, so the picture you see depends on the content as well as your equipment and connection.
What you need for 4K IPTV
Requirement What to check
A 4K TV The TV supports 4K, and the HDMI port you use supports 4K.
A 4K-capable device For example a Fire TV Stick 4K, an Apple TV 4K, a 4K Android TV or Google TV box, or a 4K Smart TV with a compatible player.
A compatible IPTV player Any player that accepts Xtream Codes or an M3U link, such as IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV or NET IPTV.
Enough internet speed About 25 Mbps or more for each 4K stream.
A wired connection Ethernet is steadier than Wi-Fi for 4K and live sport.
A subscription with 4K content Prime IPTV includes 4K, and all PPV channels in 4K and FHD.
Internet speed for 4K IPTV
Quality Approximate speed per screen
SD 5 Mbps
HD 10 Mbps
FHD (1080p) 15 Mbps
4K 25 Mbps or more
These are rough guide values, not guarantees. Multiply them by the number of screens streaming together, so two 4K screens need roughly 50 Mbps before anything else on your network. See the internet speed requirements for more.

How to set up 4K IPTV
Check your TV and HDMI port for 4K support.
Choose a 4K-capable device (the device table further down lists the options) and connect it with Ethernet if you can.
Install a compatible player using the device setup guides .
Get your login. Request the 24-hour free trial (no credit card) or choose a plan .
Add the login in the player and open a channel or movie available in 4K.
Confirm the picture. If it stutters, drop to FHD and work through the checks below.
If 4K stutters or buffers
Switch to an FHD version of the channel. A steady FHD picture beats a stuttering 4K one.
Use Ethernet instead of Wi-Fi, or move closer to the router and use the 5 GHz band.
Reduce other heavy use: downloads, backups and extra 4K streams.
Restart the player, the device and the router, and update the player app.
Check the HDMI cable and port support 4K.
The full checklist is in our buffering and login guide .

4K IPTV box: do you need one?
Most people do not need a special 4K IPTV box. A Fire TV Stick 4K, an Apple TV 4K, a 4K Android TV or Google TV box, or a 4K Smart TV with a compatible player is enough, and Prime IPTV works on all of them, plus MAG boxes. If you already own one, you can test 4K today. Read IPTV box in Canada: do you need one? before you buy hardware.
4K live IPTV: sports and PPV
Live sport is where a good 4K picture matters most. Prime IPTV carries Canadian, US and international sports, and every PPV channel is available in 4K and FHD. Test a live game at peak time during your free trial, on a wired connection, and see sports and PPV on Prime IPTV .

Frequently asked questions
What is 4K IPTV? 4K IPTV is IPTV delivered in 4K (Ultra HD) quality, which is 3840 × 2160 pixels. You need a 4K TV, a 4K-capable device and player, and a stable connection of about 25 Mbps or more per stream.
Does Prime IPTV have 4K? Yes. Prime IPTV streams in SD, HD, FHD and 4K where the content supports it, and all PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD.
What internet speed do I need for 4K IPTV? As a rough guide, about 25 Mbps or more per 4K stream. Multiply that by the number of screens streaming at the same time, and use a wired connection if you can.
Do I need a special box for 4K IPTV? No special Prime IPTV box is needed. You need a 4K-capable device you already own or can buy, such as a Fire TV Stick 4K, an Apple TV 4K or a 4K Android TV box, plus a compatible player.
Why does my 4K IPTV buffer? The usual causes are Wi-Fi, too many streams running at once, an older device or player settings. Try Ethernet, switch to FHD, restart the player and router, and see the buffering and login guide.
Is 4K available for sports and PPV? All PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD. Sports channels are available in the best quality the content supports.
Who is the best 4K IPTV provider in Canada? Prime IPTV is our pick. It streams in 4K where the content supports it, includes all PPV channels in 4K and FHD, publishes its prices, offers a 24-hour free trial with no card and backs every plan with a 7-day money-back guarantee.
Do I need a 4K IPTV box? Usually not. A Fire TV Stick 4K, Apple TV 4K, 4K Android TV or Google TV box, or a 4K Smart TV with a compatible player works with Prime IPTV. MAG boxes are supported too.
How much does 4K IPTV cost in Canada? Prime IPTV plans include 4K and start at $34.99 CAD for 3 months with 1 connection. You can choose 1 to 4 connections and 3, 6, 12 or 24 months.
Can I watch live sports in 4K on IPTV? Yes, where the content is offered in 4K. All PPV channels on Prime IPTV are available in 4K and FHD, and sports channels come in the best quality the content supports. Test a live game during the free trial.

## About Prime IPTV: Premium IPTV Service Canada
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/about/

About Us
About Prime IPTV
Prime IPTV (primeiptv4k.ca) is an IPTV subscription service for viewers in Canada, also available worldwide. It is not a player app: you subscribe to Prime IPTV and watch through any compatible IPTV player on your own device. Learn the difference between an IPTV service and a player app .
Prime IPTV is an IPTV subscription service built for viewers in Canada.
Prime IPTV brings live TV, sports, PPV, movies, series, VOD and 4K streaming to viewers in Canada, with flexible subscription options and round-the-clock customer support.
Our goal is simple: an easy, flexible way to watch on compatible devices, with no contracts, no complications and none of the limits of traditional cable TV.
What We Offer
25,000+ Live Channels Entertainment, sports, news, international, kids, and more.
120,000+ Movies & Series A large on-demand library of movies and series.

Sports & PPV Major sports packages and PPV events.
EPG Electronic Program Guide included with all plans.
Multiple Connections Plans available with 1 to 4 simultaneous connections.
24/7 Support Customer support available via WhatsApp and email.
No Contract Cancel anytime. No commitment required.

## Best IPTV Players and Apps (2026): Firestick, Android TV, Smart TV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/best-iptv-players/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
Best IPTV Players and Apps (2026): Firestick, Android TV, Smart TV
Published October 5, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 6 min read
The best IPTV player is the one that suits your device. An IPTV subscription gives you login details, but you still need a player app to use them. The right player depends mostly on your device. If you are new to the difference, start with IPTV service vs IPTV player app .
Quick comparison
Player Typical devices Login methods Worth knowing
TiviMate Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV Xtream Codes, M3U Popular for its EPG layout and channel grouping. Some features sit in a paid tier.
IPTV Smarters Pro Android, iOS, Fire TV and some Smart TVs Xtream Codes (and playlists in some versions) Separate sections for live TV, movies and series; quick to set up.
GSE Smart IPTV iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Android M3U, Xtream Codes A common choice on Apple devices where options are fewer.
Smart IPTV Samsung and LG Smart TVs M3U playlist Tied to your TV's MAC address. Check the app's current terms before you start.
IBO Player Smart TVs and other devices MAC address, then playlist (Xtream Codes or M3U) Loads the playlist against your device's MAC address. Send us the MAC address on WhatsApp and we will help you set it up.
Set IPTV Smart TVs and other devices MAC address, then playlist (Xtream Codes or M3U) Same MAC-address approach as IBO Player.
NET IPTV Smart TVs and other devices MAC address, then playlist (Xtream Codes or M3U) Same MAC-address approach as IBO Player.
VLC Windows, Mac, Android, iOS M3U A general media player: it plays streams but is not built around a TV guide or on-demand library.
Availability, features and pricing change over time, so check each app's store listing for the latest details.
What works with Prime IPTV?
Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link , including IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV. Some players (IBO Player, Set IPTV, NET IPTV and similar) load the playlist through your device's MAC address : message us on WhatsApp with the MAC address shown in the app and we will help you add your playlist. For a MAG box, send us its MAC address and we activate your subscription and send your portal links.
Which player for which device?
Firestick / Fire TV: TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro, installed with the Downloader app (neither is listed in the Amazon Appstore). See the Firestick guide .
Android TV / Google TV boxes: TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro from Google Play. See the Android TV guide .
iPhone, iPad and Apple TV: GSE Smart IPTV or IPTV Smarters. See the Apple TV guide and phone guide .
Samsung and LG Smart TVs: IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, Set IPTV, NET IPTV, Smart IPTV or another player available in your TV's app store. See the Smart TV guide .
Windows and Mac: a desktop IPTV player or VLC. See the computer guide .
What to look for in a player
It supports your login method. Xtream Codes is the most widely supported; M3U works almost everywhere.
A readable TV guide (EPG). This is the biggest difference between players in daily use.
Favourites and channel groups. With thousands of channels, being able to hide what you never watch matters.
Buffer and decoder options. These settings help when your connection or device is the limiting factor. See our troubleshooting guide .
Catch-up support. Whether you can replay earlier programmes depends on the player you use.
Using Prime IPTV with these players
Using IPTV Smarters Pro? See IPTV Smarters Pro subscription: what you need , and for 4K playback read the 4K IPTV guide . Prime IPTV is a subscription service that works with compatible IPTV players. Once you request the 24-hour free trial or choose a plan , you receive your login details and add them to the player of your choice. The device setup guides walk through each step.
Quick answers
Do I need to pay for an IPTV player?
Many players are free to install; some offer paid features or activation. Check each app's store listing for current terms.
Can I use more than one player?
Yes. You can install different players on different devices, and several players on one device if you like. Your plan's number of connections still limits how many streams run at once.
Does the player affect picture quality?
The stream quality comes from the service and your connection, but a player with good decoder and buffer options can make playback smoother on some devices.
Which player should I try first?
On Firestick or Android TV, start with TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro. On iPhone, iPad or Apple TV, start with GSE Smart IPTV or IPTV Smarters.

## How Many IPTV Connections Do You Need? (1 to 4 Plan Guide)
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/how-many-iptv-connections-do-i-need/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
How Many IPTV Connections Do You Need? (1 to 4 Plan Guide)
Published October 5, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 5 min read
Prime IPTV plans come with 1, 2, 3 or 4 connections . The right number saves money if you would have over-bought, and saves frustration if you would have under-bought. Need more than 4? Message us on WhatsApp or email and we will quote a plan for more devices. This guide explains what a connection is and helps you pick.
What is an IPTV connection?
In IPTV, a connection normally means one stream playing at a time on your subscription. It is about how many screens are watching at the same moment , not how many devices you have installed the player on. You can set up a player on a Firestick, a phone and a laptop, but with a 1-connection plan only one of them can stream at once.
How to count your connections
List every screen that might be watching in the evening: living room, bedroom, kids' room, phone, tablet and computer.
Decide the most that would run together on a busy night. That number is your starting point.
If it is more than 4, contact us about options.
Also remember the internet limit: every extra simultaneous stream uses bandwidth. As a rough guide, plan for about 10 Mbps per HD stream and 25 Mbps per 4K stream. Several 4K screens at once need a fast connection, so check the internet speed requirements and our buffering guide .
Quick chooser
How many screens might stream at the same time?
1 2 3 4 5 or more

How to Watch TV Without Cable in Canada
Published October 26, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 6 min read
Cutting the cord in Canada comes down to three things: a stable internet connection, a device that can stream, and a service to watch. Here is the simple path.
1. Check your internet
You need about 5 Mbps per screen for SD, 10 for HD, 15 for FHD and 25 or more for 4K. Add them up for the screens that run at once. Our speed guide has the full table.
2. Pick a device
Smart TV. Install a player app from the TV's app store.
Firestick or Fire TV. A popular, low-cost option. See the Firestick guide .
Android TV box, Apple TV or Roku. All have setup guides .
Phone, tablet or computer. Good for travel and second screens.
3. Choose what to watch
Many people mix a few streaming apps with one live-TV service. Prime IPTV covers live channels, sports, PPV and on-demand movies and series in one subscription, so you rely on fewer apps.
4. Test before you commit
Start the 24-hour free trial , add the login to your player and test the channels you watch most. Choose a plan only if it works on your connection.

No. A device you already own is usually enough.

## IPTV Not Working? Fix Buffering, Login and Channel Problems
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/iptv-buffering-troubleshooting/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
IPTV Not Working? Fix Buffering, Login and Channel Problems
Published October 5, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 7 min read
If your IPTV is not working, the cause is very often local. Prime IPTV is built for smooth, buffer-free viewing on premium servers. When a stream does stutter, freeze or refuse to load, the cause is very often local: the Wi-Fi, the device, the player settings or a small typo in the login. Work through this checklist from the top, because most problems are solved in the first few steps.
Part 1: Buffering and freezing
1. Test whether it is one channel or everything
Open a different channel, then a different category. If only one channel misbehaves, note its name and the time and tell support. If everything buffers, the problem is probably on your side of the connection.
2. Check your internet speed
Run a speed test on the same device and network. As a rough guide, one stream needs roughly the following (see the full internet speed requirements for several screens at once):
Quality Approximate speed per stream
SD 5 Mbps
HD 10 Mbps
Full HD 15 Mbps
4K 25 Mbps or more
These are rough guide values, not guarantees. Multiply them by the number of screens streaming at once, and remember that other people in the house share the connection.
3. Use a cable if you can
Wi-Fi is the most common cause of buffering, especially in another room or on a crowded network. Connect your TV box or Firestick with Ethernet (a Fire TV Ethernet adapter works), or move closer to the router and use the 5 GHz band.
4. Restart the chain
Restart the player app, then the device, then the router, in that order. Unplug the router for 30 seconds before switching it back on.
5. Free up bandwidth
Pause large downloads and cloud backups, and check whether another screen is streaming 4K. Fewer heavy streams at the same time leaves more room for yours.
6. Adjust player settings
Try a lower quality version of the channel (FHD instead of 4K, or HD instead of FHD).
Increase the player's buffer size if it has that option.
Switch hardware decoding on or off. One setting is often smoother on a given device.
Update the player app, and clear its cache from the device's app settings.
7. Test without a VPN or proxy
If you normally run a VPN or proxy on the device or router, switch it off briefly to see whether it is slowing the stream.
Part 2: Login and "channels will not load"
Re-enter the details carefully. Copy and paste the server URL, username and password from your WhatsApp or email message. Look for a trailing space, a missing "http://" or letters that look alike (0/O, l/I).
Use the right login method. If your player offers both Xtream Codes and M3U, use the one our message gave you. Smart TV and MAG apps may need MAC-address activation instead. See the Smart TV and MAG guides.
Check your plan's connections. If more screens are streaming than your plan allows, extra streams may be refused. See how many connections you need .
Check the trial or plan period. A 24-hour trial ends after 24 hours; a paid plan ends at its end date.
Confirm the device clock and internet. A wrong date or no internet can prevent a login from working.
Part 3: TV guide (EPG) problems
Refresh or reload the EPG from your player's settings, and allow a few minutes to finish.
Make sure the player's EPG option is switched on for your playlist.
Catch-up (replaying earlier programmes) depends on the player you use, so check that your player supports it.
Still stuck? Contact support
Our team is available 24/7 by WhatsApp and email at contactiptv.amelia@gmail.com . To get help faster, include the following:
Your device and the player app you use.
The channel name and the time the problem happened.
What you see (error message, black screen, freezing) and what you already tried.
Whether it happens on Wi-Fi, wired, or both.
New to setup? Our device setup guides cover Firestick, Smart TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Roku, phones, tablets, computers and MAG boxes step by step.

## IPTV EPG Explained: How the TV Guide Works
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/iptv-epg-explained/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
IPTV EPG Explained: How the TV Guide Works
Published October 26, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 5 min read
The IPTV EPG is the TV guide in your player. EPG stands for Electronic Programme Guide. It is the schedule grid that shows what is on now and next, like the guide on a cable box.
How the guide works
Your player app loads a list of channels and then a separate file of schedule data that matches the channels by ID. Prime IPTV includes a TV guide (EPG). The look, search and catch-up features depend on the player you use.
Why a guide may be blank or wrong
The device clock or time zone is wrong. Set it to automatic.
The guide has not finished loading. Give the player a few minutes after the first login.
The player's guide cache is stale. Refresh the guide or reload the playlist in settings.
A channel has no matching guide data, so it shows a blank row.
How to fix it
Check the time and time zone on your device.
Refresh the EPG in your player's settings.
Restart the app, then the device.
If the problem remains, contact support with your device, player, channel and the time it happened.
Quick answers
Does every player show the guide the same way?
No. Layout and extra features such as catch-up differ by player.
Is the EPG included?
Yes, a TV guide is included with Prime IPTV.

## IPTV M3U vs Xtream Codes: Which Login Should You Use?
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/iptv-m3u-vs-xtream-codes/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
IPTV M3U vs Xtream Codes: Which Login Should You Use?
Published October 26, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 5 min read
When you subscribe to an IPTV service you receive a login, and it usually comes in one of two forms: an Xtream Codes login or an M3U playlist link . Both connect your player app to the service, but they work differently. This guide explains the difference and which one to use.
What is an Xtream Codes login?
An Xtream Codes login (also called the Xtream Codes API) is made of three details: a server URL , a username and a password . You type them into a player that supports Xtream Codes, such as IPTV Smarters Pro or TiviMate, and the player loads the live channels, categories, on-demand movies and series and the TV guide (EPG) for you.
What is an M3U playlist?
An M3U playlist is a single link or file that lists channels. You paste the link into a player, and the player reads the list. The same file format is used by many media players, including VLC. An M3U link often has your username and password built into the address, so treat it like a password and do not share it. The TV guide may need a separate EPG link, and on-demand titles may be mixed into the channel list or missing, depending on the player.
M3U vs Xtream Codes at a glance
Xtream Codes M3U playlist
What you enter Server URL, username, password One playlist link
Live TV and categories Loaded with categories Loaded as one list
On-demand movies and series Separate sections in most players Depends on the player
TV guide (EPG) Usually loads automatically May need a separate EPG link
Typical players IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate VLC, GSE Smart IPTV, many Smart TV apps
Which should you use?
Use Xtream Codes if your player offers it. It is the simplest way to get live TV, on-demand titles and the guide in one login.
Use M3U if your player or device only accepts a playlist link, for example VLC on a computer or some Smart TV apps.
Use MAC-address activation for players such as IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV, and for MAG boxes. Send us the MAC address shown in the app and we set it up.
What you get with Prime IPTV
Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link . Your login normally arrives as a server URL, username and password by WhatsApp or email. If your player needs an M3U link, ask support and we will send one. The device setup guides show exactly where to enter the details on each device, and you can test everything with the 24-hour free trial .
Common problems
Login fails: check for a space at the start or end and for a missing "http://". Copy and paste instead of typing.
Channels load but there is no guide: refresh the EPG in the player. See IPTV EPG explained .
Playlist will not load: copy the whole link again, and use Xtream Codes instead if your player supports it. More fixes are in IPTV not working? buffering and login fixes .
Quick answers
Is Xtream Codes an app?
No. Xtream Codes is a type of login that many IPTV players accept. You still need a subscription and a player app.
Is an M3U link safe to share?
No. It usually contains your login, so keep it private.
Can I use both in different players?
Yes, within your plan's connection limit.

## IPTV Service vs IPTV Player App: What’s the Difference?
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/iptv-service-vs-iptv-player-app/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
IPTV Service vs IPTV Player App: What’s the Difference?
Published October 5, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 5 min read
Two very different things are both called "IPTV" online, and mixing them up is the most common reason people get stuck during setup. One is an IPTV service . The other is an IPTV player app . You need both to watch, but each does a different job.
The short answer
An IPTV service provides the channels, the on-demand library and your login. An IPTV player app only displays what a service gives it. A player on its own shows nothing until you add a login from a provider.
IPTV service (the provider)
Runs the servers that deliver live channels and on-demand content.
Gives you login details after you subscribe or request a trial. That can be a server URL, username and password (Xtream Codes), a playlist link (M3U), a portal link for MAG boxes, or your device's MAC address for MAC-based players such as IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV.
Sets how many screens can watch at once (your number of connections) and how long your subscription lasts.
Provides support for account and stream issues.
Prime IPTV (primeiptv4k.ca) is an IPTV service : 25,000+ live channels, 120,000+ movies and series, SD to 4K, EPG, sports and PPV, with plans for 1 to 4 connections.
IPTV player app (the software)
Installs on your device, such as a Firestick, Android TV, Apple TV, phone, tablet or computer.
Takes the login you received from a provider and shows the channel list, TV guide and on-demand library.
Controls the viewing experience: layout, favourites, EPG display, buffering options.
Does not include channels or movies of its own.
Popular players include IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, GSE Smart IPTV and Smart IPTV. See our player comparison .
Why the names cause confusion
App stores list many players whose names look like provider brands, so searching for a service name can return an app instead. Those apps usually say in their store description that they provide no content. If you find an app with a name similar to a service, check what it says it provides. A player with no content is simply a player.
Prime IPTV is a subscription service, not a player app. You watch it through a compatible player on your device.
How the two fit together
Feature IPTV service IPTV player app
Provides channels and VOD Yes No
Provides your login Yes No
Installed on your device No Yes
Shows the TV guide and channel list Supplies the data Displays it
You pay for it Subscription Often free; some players have paid features
If you are specifically looking for an IPTV Smarters Pro subscription , that guide explains how the app and the subscription fit together.
Set up in three steps
Get a service login. Start the 24-hour free trial or choose a plan . You receive your login details by WhatsApp or email.
Install a player on your device from its app store.
Add your login in the player. Our device guides show the exact steps for each device.
If channels do not load, see IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Quick answers
Can an IPTV player work without a service?
A player can open any playlist or login you give it, but on its own it has no channels. You need a service for content.
Is Prime IPTV an app?
No. Prime IPTV is a subscription service. You watch it through a compatible IPTV player on your device.
What do I receive when I subscribe?
Login details, normally a server URL, username and password or a playlist link, sent by email or WhatsApp.
Do I pay twice, once for the app and once for the service?
You pay for the service. Many players are free to install, though some offer optional paid features.

IPTV vs Cable TV: What You’re Actually Trading Off
Published October 5, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 6 min read
Both IPTV and cable let you watch live television, but they deliver it in very different ways, and each has real trade-offs. This guide compares them point by point so you can decide what suits your household.
At a glance
Feature IPTV (e.g. Prime IPTV) Traditional cable TV
How it arrives Over your internet connection Over the provider's cable network
Equipment A compatible device and a player app you already own or can install Provider-supplied set-top box
Channels Very large lineups (Prime IPTV: 25,000+ live channels) Packages with a fixed number of channels per tier
On-demand library Large VOD library (Prime IPTV: 120,000+ movies & series) Usually a smaller on-demand selection
Screens TVs, phones, tablets and computers, within your connection limit Usually tied to boxes in specific rooms
Contract Prime IPTV has no contract and offers cancellation Often term-based agreements
Depends on home internet Yes No
Quality SD, HD, FHD and 4K where supported Depends on package and box
Channels and content
Cable bundles channels into packages, so a bigger lineup usually means a higher tier. IPTV services typically offer a far larger catalogue in one subscription, plus a large on-demand library. The practical question is not how many channels exist but whether the ones you watch are included, which is exactly what a trial is for. Our 24-hour trial checklist shows how to test that.

Cable relies on equipment from the provider. IPTV runs on devices you may already have: Smart TVs, Fire TV and Android TV, Apple TV, phones, tablets and computers. See the supported device guides .

Dependence on your internet. If your home connection is slow or unstable, streams will suffer. Wired connections help; see buffering and login fixes .
A little setup. You add a login to a player once. It takes minutes with our step-by-step guides , but it is not a plug-in box.
The established cable infrastructure. Cable is a mature, regulated service with a long track record. IPTV providers vary widely, so it is worth testing before you commit.
What you gain
A much larger channel and on-demand library in one subscription.
Use on several screens, with plans for up to 4 connections.
No installation visit and no contract.
Which should you choose?
If you want maximum simplicity and have no reliable broadband, cable may still suit you. If you have a stable internet connection and want a bigger lineup on more screens without a contract, IPTV is worth testing. The lowest-risk way to find out is to try Prime IPTV free for 24 hours (no credit card required) and compare it with what you watch today.

You need a stable connection, roughly 10 Mbps for HD and 25 Mbps for 4K per screen. See the speed requirements guide for the full table.

## Is IPTV Legal in Canada? What Viewers Should Know
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/is-iptv-legal-in-canada/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
Is IPTV Legal in Canada? What Viewers Should Know
Published October 26, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 6 min read
This guide is general information, not legal advice. If you need certainty about your own situation, speak to a Canadian lawyer.
The technology is not the issue
IPTV simply means television delivered over the internet. Many large, licensed Canadian and international broadcasters and streaming companies use it. So the real question is never "is IPTV legal?" but "is this particular service, and the content it carries, properly licensed?"
What decides whether a service is lawful
Licensing. In Canada, copyright is governed by the Copyright Act, and broadcasting is regulated by the CRTC. Distributing or streaming content without the rights holder's permission can infringe copyright.
The source of the content. A provider that has agreements with rights holders is in a different position from one that re-streams channels without permission.
How the service is run. Canadian courts have ordered internet providers to block some unauthorized streaming services, so enforcement is real.
Questions to ask any IPTV provider
Can you explain where your content comes from and how it is licensed?
Do you publish terms, a privacy policy, a refund policy and a copyright (DMCA) contact?
Is there a business contact I can reach and a trial before I pay?
Are prices, plans and cancellation rules stated clearly?
Where Prime IPTV stands
Prime IPTV publishes its terms , privacy policy , refund policy and DMCA notice , and a disclaimer that explains viewers are responsible for making sure their use of the service complies with the laws that apply to them. We do not give legal advice, and we encourage you to check the rules that apply to you.
Quick answers
Can I get in trouble for watching?
Rules differ by situation and change over time. Ask a lawyer if you are unsure.
Is a free trial a safe way to look?
A trial lets you test quality and channels without paying, but it does not change the licensing question above.

## What Is IPTV in Canada? Meaning, How It Works and What You Need
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/blog/what-is-iptv/

Back to Blog IPTV Guide
What Is IPTV in Canada? Meaning, How It Works and What You Need
Published October 5, 2026 · By the Prime IPTV team · 6 min read
The IPTV meaning is simple: IPTV stands for Internet Protocol Television . Instead of receiving television through a cable box, a satellite dish or an antenna, IPTV delivers channels and videos over your internet connection, the same one that carries websites, video calls and streaming apps.
How IPTV works
With cable, every channel is broadcast to your home all the time and your set-top box picks one. With IPTV, nothing is sent until you ask for it. When you select a channel or a movie, your device requests that stream from a server and the video is delivered to you over the internet.
A provider runs the servers and gives you login details (for example a server address, a username and a password, or a playlist link).
A player app on your device uses those details to load the channel list, TV guide and on-demand library.
Your internet connection carries the stream. The better and more stable the connection, the better the picture.
This split matters: the provider supplies the content and the login, and the player only displays it. We explain it in more detail in IPTV service vs IPTV player app .
What you need to watch IPTV
A compatible device: a Smart TV, Fire TV or Firestick, Android TV, Apple TV, a phone or tablet, a computer or a MAG box. See the device setup guides .
An IPTV player app that supports your provider's login method.
An IPTV subscription that gives you the login details.
A stable internet connection. As a rough guide, you need about 5 Mbps for SD, 10 Mbps for HD, 15 Mbps for Full HD and 25 Mbps or more for 4K, and more if several screens stream at once. See our internet speed requirements for the full table.
What you can watch
A typical IPTV subscription mixes several kinds of content.
Live TV: news, entertainment, kids, international and sports channels. Prime IPTV includes 25,000+ live channels.
VOD (video on demand): a library of movies and series you can start whenever you like. Prime IPTV includes 120,000+ movies and series.
PPV (pay-per-view) events where available.
EPG (electronic program guide): the on-screen TV schedule.
IPTV terms you will see
Term What it means
EPG The TV guide: what is on now and next, per channel.
VOD Movies and series you can play on demand.
PPV Pay-per-view events, such as fights or special broadcasts, that you access one at a time.
Xtream Codes login A common login method: server URL + username + password. Most players support it. See M3U vs Xtream Codes .
M3U playlist A playlist link or file that lists channels. Some players and devices use it instead of Xtream Codes.
Catch-up Watching a programme that already aired. Availability depends on the player you use.
Simultaneous connection One stream playing at a time on your subscription. See how many connections you need .
IPTV compared with cable
IPTV usually offers a much larger channel and on-demand library, works on many devices instead of one box, and needs no equipment installation. Cable offers long-established infrastructure and does not depend on your home internet. Our full comparison is in IPTV vs cable TV .
Is IPTV legal?
IPTV is a delivery technology, and the technology itself is not the issue. What matters is whether the content you watch is distributed with the rights to do so. You are responsible for making sure your use of any service complies with the laws and regulations that apply to you.
How to try IPTV
The simplest way to see whether IPTV suits you is to test it on your own device and connection. Prime IPTV offers a 24-hour free trial with no credit card required . Our trial checklist shows what to test while you have it.

To File a DMCA Notice

A physical or electronic signature of a person authorized to act on behalf of the copyright owner
Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed

A statement that you have a good faith belief that use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law

## Prime IPTV FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/faq/

FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
43 answers about Prime IPTV, grouped by topic. Can’t find yours? Message us any time, because support is 24/7.
General questions Plans, pricing and payment Free trial Devices, apps and setup Quality, features and performance Support, refunds and policies General questions
What is IPTV? IPTV, short for Internet Protocol Television, is TV that arrives over your internet connection instead of through cable, satellite or an antenna. A provider supplies the channels and your login, and a player app on your device displays them.
Is Prime IPTV a player app? No. Prime IPTV (primeiptv4k.ca) is an IPTV subscription service with live TV, sports and on-demand content for viewers in Canada. Some player apps in app stores have similar names, but they are separate products. To watch Prime IPTV you add your login to a compatible IPTV player.
What is Prime IPTV? Prime IPTV is an IPTV subscription service with 25,000+ live TV channels, 120,000+ movies and series, sports, PPV and on-demand content on compatible streaming devices. It serves Canada first and is available worldwide too.
How many channels does Prime IPTV offer? More than 25,000 live TV channels, covering entertainment, sports, news, kids and family programming, and international content.
Which countries’ channels are included? All Canadian and US channels and channels from other countries, including sports channels.
Does Prime IPTV have Canadian sports? Yes. Canadian sports are included, along with US sports and sports from other countries.
Are PPV channels available in 4K? Yes. All PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD.
How many movies and series are available? More than 120,000 movies and series, in the VOD (video on demand) library.
What is the difference between an IPTV service and an IPTV player app? An IPTV service provides the channels, the on-demand library and your login. A player app only displays what a service gives it and has no channels of its own. Prime IPTV is a subscription service, and you watch it through a compatible player on your device.
Is IPTV legal? IPTV is a delivery technology, and the technology itself is not the issue. What matters is whether the content you watch is distributed with the rights to do so. You are responsible for making sure your use of any service complies with the laws and regulations that apply to you.
Is Prime IPTV available outside Canada? Prime IPTV serves viewers across Canada and is available worldwide as well. Your experience still depends on your local internet connection.
Plans, pricing and payment
Do you offer more than 4 devices? Yes. Standard plans cover 1 to 4 devices (connections). If you need more than 4 devices, message us on WhatsApp or email us and we will quote a plan for you.
How much does Prime IPTV cost? Plans start at $34.99 CAD for 3 months with 1 connection. Additional plans are available for 6 months ($49.99 CAD), 12 months ($79.99 CAD) and 24 months ($124.99 CAD), and with 2, 3 and 4 connections. See the pricing page for every price.
What does +1 month free and +2 months free mean? 6-month and 12-month plans include 1 extra month at no charge, and 24-month plans include 2 extra months at no charge.
What is a connection, and how many do I need? A connection is one stream playing at a time. Count the most screens that might play together on a busy evening and choose a plan with that many connections. Prime IPTV plans cover 1, 2, 3 or 4 connections.
What if I need more than 4 connections? Message us on WhatsApp or send an email and we will suggest the best option.
How do I buy a plan? Press Buy Now! on the plan you want. WhatsApp opens with your plan and price already in the message, and we send you the payment details.
What payment methods are accepted? You can pay with a credit card or a debit card.
Is there a contract? No. There is no contract, and cancellation is available.
Free trial
Does Prime IPTV offer a free trial? Yes, there is a 24-hour free trial. Request it on WhatsApp or by email, and we send your trial details by WhatsApp or email.
Do I need a credit card for the free trial? No. The 24-hour free trial does not require a credit card.
How should I use the 24 hours? Install a player first, then test the channels and sports you watch most, a busy-evening slot, picture quality, the TV guide, the on-demand library and support. Our free-trial checklist covers each step.
What happens when the trial ends? The trial ends after 24 hours. To keep watching, choose a plan on the pricing page. There is no contract.
Devices, apps and setup
What devices does Prime IPTV support? Prime IPTV works with compatible IPTV players on Smart TVs, Fire TV and Firestick, Android TV, Apple TV, Roku, smartphones, tablets, computers and MAG boxes.
Do I need a special box? No. Most people use a device they already own with a compatible player app.
What IPTV players work with Prime IPTV? Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link, such as IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV. Players that use your device’s MAC address (like IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV) load the playlist against that address.
How do I set up a MAG box? Message us on WhatsApp with your MAG box MAC address. We activate your subscription and send you your portal links to enter in the box.
What should I do for a MAC-address player such as IBO Player, Set IPTV or NET IPTV? Note the MAC address shown in the app and send it to us on WhatsApp. We will help you add your playlist.
How quickly will I receive my login? For a paid plan, activation is normally within a few minutes after payment. Your login details arrive by email or WhatsApp.
What are Xtream Codes and M3U? They are two common ways to log in. Xtream Codes uses a server URL, username and password. M3U uses a playlist link or file. Most players support at least one of them, and our device guides show which to use.
Why can I not find my player in my TV’s app store? Smart TV app availability differs by brand, region and model year. Try another listed player, or connect a Firestick or Android TV box to the same TV.
Quality, features and performance
Does Prime IPTV support 4K? Yes, for compatible content and devices. SD, HD and FHD are supported as well.
What internet speed do I need? As a rough guide, about 5 Mbps for SD, 10 Mbps for HD, 15 Mbps for FHD and 25 Mbps or more for 4K, per screen. Multiply that by the number of screens streaming at the same time.
Does Prime IPTV have EPG? Yes. An EPG (electronic program guide) is included.
Is Catch-Up available? Catch-Up availability depends on the IPTV player you use. Check your player’s settings for catch-up support.
Does Prime IPTV offer sports and PPV? Yes. Sports programming covers all major sports packages, and PPV events are available where offered.
What should I do if a channel buffers or will not load? Check your internet speed, use a wired connection if you can, and restart the player and your router. Re-enter your login carefully too. If it still fails, contact support and tell us your device, player, channel and the time it happened. Our buffering and login guide has the full checklist.
What uptime does Prime IPTV have? Prime IPTV runs on premium servers designed for 99.9% uptime.
Support, refunds and policies
Is customer support available 24/7? Yes. Support is available 24/7 by WhatsApp and email.
How do I contact Prime IPTV? Message us on WhatsApp at +1 (406) 235-6618, email contactiptv.amelia@gmail.com, or call +1 (406) 235-6618. Our address is 4793 County Rd 772B, Webster, FL 33597, USA.
Is there a money-back guarantee? Yes. Subscriptions come with a 7-day money-back guarantee. The refund policy explains how to request a refund.
Can I cancel my subscription? Yes. There is no contract, and cancellation is available.
Where can I read your policies? The refund policy, terms of service, privacy policy and DMCA notice are linked in the footer of every page.

L’IPTV au Canada
Conçu pour les spectateurs canadiens, d’un océan à l’autre
Prime IPTV passe par Internet; il ne dépend donc pas d’un réseau local de câble ou de satellite. Si votre maison ou votre chalet a une connexion stable, vous pouvez regarder, que vous soyez dans un condo de Toronto, une maison de Calgary ou une petite ville des Maritimes.
À titre indicatif, il faut environ 5 Mb/s pour la SD, 10 pour la HD, 15 pour la FHD et 25 ou plus pour le 4K, par écran.

Abonnement IPTV au Canada : comment choisir
Un bon fournisseur IPTV au Canada se reconnaît à ce qu’il vous laisse l’essayer d’abord, affiche ses prix et ne vous enferme pas dans un contrat. Avec Prime IPTV, vous demandez l’ essai gratuit de 24 heures , vous comparez les forfaits dès 34,99 $ CAD , puis vous payez par WhatsApp. Les forfaits vont de 1 à 4 connexions, et pour plus de 4 appareils il suffit de nous écrire. Prime IPTV est un service IPTV axé sur le Canada, avec du soutien en français sur WhatsApp. Vous cherchez un abonnement IPTV pas cher, un forfait IPTV pour le Québec, un fournisseur IPTV fiable ou le meilleur IPTV au Canada? Bon à savoir
L’IPTV est-il légal au Canada?
L’IPTV est une technologie de diffusion, et la technologie elle-même n’est pas en cause. Ce qui compte, c’est que le contenu que vous regardez soit autorisé là où vous habitez. Les règles varient selon les pays et changent avec le temps; vérifiez donc ce qui s’applique à vous. Les spectateurs doivent s’assurer que leur utilisation du service respecte les lois et règlements qui s’appliquent à eux. Lisez nos conditions , notre politique de confidentialité et notre politique de remboursement avant de vous abonner.

FAQ
Prime IPTV : vos questions, nos réponses
Qu’est-ce que l’IPTV? IPTV signifie télévision par protocole Internet : la télé arrive par votre connexion Internet plutôt que par le câble, le satellite ou une antenne. Vous ouvrez une application de lecture sur votre appareil, vous entrez votre identifiant et vous regardez des chaînes en direct et des films sur demande.
Prime IPTV est-il une application de lecture? Non. Prime IPTV (primeiptv4k.ca) est un service d’abonnement IPTV avec télé en direct, sport et contenu sur demande pour les spectateurs au Canada. Certaines applications de lecture des boutiques d’applications ont des noms semblables, mais ce sont des produits distincts. Pour regarder Prime IPTV, vous ajoutez votre identifiant à un lecteur IPTV compatible.
Qu’est-ce que Prime IPTV? Prime IPTV est un abonnement IPTV pour les spectateurs au Canada, également offert dans le monde entier. Il comprend plus de 25 000 chaînes en direct, plus de 120 000 films et séries, du sport, du PPV, un guide des programmes (EPG) et du 4K lorsque votre appareil et le contenu le permettent.
Prime IPTV fonctionne-t-il au Canada? Oui. Prime IPTV est conçu pour les spectateurs au Canada et fonctionne dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires, de Toronto et Montréal à Vancouver, Calgary et Halifax. Il vous faut un appareil compatible, une application de lecture et une connexion Internet stable de n’importe quel fournisseur canadien.
Quelles provinces canadiennes sont couvertes? Toutes : Ontario, Québec, Colombie-Britannique, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Nouvelle-Écosse, Nouveau-Brunswick, Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador, Île-du-Prince-Édouard et les trois territoires. L’IPTV passe par Internet; la couverture dépend donc de votre connexion, et non d’un réseau local de câble ou de satellite.
Combien de chaînes Prime IPTV offre-t-il? Plus de 25 000 chaînes de télé en direct, couvrant le divertissement, le sport, les nouvelles, la jeunesse et la famille, et la programmation internationale.
Combien de films et de séries sont offerts? La vidéothèque sur demande (VOD) compte plus de 120 000 films et séries.
Offrez-vous plus de 4 appareils? Oui. Les forfaits standards couvrent de 1 à 4 appareils (connexions). Si vous avez besoin de plus de 4 appareils, écrivez-nous sur WhatsApp ou par courriel et nous vous proposerons un forfait.
Combien coûte Prime IPTV? Les forfaits commencent à 34,99 $ CAD pour 3 mois avec 1 connexion. Vous pouvez choisir 1, 2, 3 ou 4 connexions et 3, 6, 12 ou 24 mois. Les forfaits de 6, 12 et 24 mois comprennent des mois gratuits. Consultez la page des tarifs pour tous les prix.
Y a-t-il un essai gratuit, et faut-il une carte de crédit? Oui, il y a un essai gratuit de 24 heures, et il ne demande pas de carte de crédit. Nous envoyons les détails par WhatsApp ou par courriel.
Comment acheter un forfait? Choisissez un forfait et appuyez sur « Acheter maintenant ». WhatsApp s’ouvre avec votre forfait et son prix déjà dans le message, et nous vous envoyons les détails de paiement. Nous envoyons ensuite votre identifiant par courriel ou par WhatsApp.
En combien de temps recevrai-je mon identifiant? L’activation se fait normalement en quelques minutes après le paiement.
Quels appareils puis-je utiliser? Prime IPTV fonctionne avec des lecteurs IPTV compatibles sur les téléviseurs intelligents, Fire TV et Firestick, Android TV, Apple TV, Roku, les téléphones, les tablettes, les ordinateurs et les boîtiers MAG.
Ai-je besoin d’un boîtier spécial? Non. La plupart des gens utilisent un appareil qu’ils possèdent déjà, comme un téléviseur intelligent, une Firestick ou un téléphone, avec une application de lecture compatible.
Prime IPTV prend-il en charge le 4K? Oui, pour le contenu et les appareils compatibles. La SD, la HD et la FHD sont aussi prises en charge.
Quelle vitesse Internet me faut-il? À titre indicatif, il faut environ 5 Mb/s pour la SD, 10 Mb/s pour la HD, 15 Mb/s pour la FHD et 25 Mb/s ou plus pour le 4K, par écran. Multipliez par le nombre d’écrans qui joueront en même temps.
De combien de connexions ai-je besoin? Une connexion correspond à un flux en cours de lecture. Comptez le plus grand nombre d’écrans qui pourraient jouer en même temps. Les forfaits couvrent de 1 à 4 connexions.
Prime IPTV comprend-il un guide des programmes? Un guide des programmes (EPG) est inclus. Le rattrapage dépend du lecteur IPTV que vous utilisez.
Y a-t-il un contrat? Puis-je annuler? Il n’y a aucun contrat. L’annulation est possible.
Y a-t-il une garantie de remboursement? Oui. Les abonnements sont couverts par une garantie de remboursement de 7 jours. La politique de remboursement explique comment en faire la demande.
Le soutien est-il offert 24 heures sur 24? Oui. Le soutien est offert 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, par WhatsApp et par courriel.
Quelles chaînes et quels pays sont inclus? Toutes les chaînes canadiennes et américaines et les chaînes d’autres pays, y compris les chaînes sportives, ainsi que toutes les chaînes PPV en 4K et en FHD. Nous ne publions pas de liste de chaînes : utilisez l’essai gratuit pour vérifier celles que vous voulez.
Puis-je regarder des chaînes en français? Écrivez-nous sur WhatsApp et dites-nous quelles chaînes vous voulez. Nous vous répondons avant l’achat, et l’essai gratuit vous permet de vérifier vous-même.
Quels lecteurs fonctionnent avec Prime IPTV? Tout lecteur qui accepte les codes Xtream ou un lien M3U fonctionne, par exemple IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV et NET IPTV. Les lecteurs à adresse MAC chargent la liste de lecture selon l’adresse MAC de votre appareil.
Comment configurer un boîtier MAG? Envoyez-nous l’adresse MAC de votre boîtier MAG sur WhatsApp. Nous activons votre abonnement et vous envoyons vos liens de portail.
Que faire si une chaîne fige ou ne se charge pas? Vérifiez votre vitesse Internet, utilisez une connexion filaire si possible et redémarrez votre lecteur et votre routeur. Saisissez de nouveau votre identifiant avec soin. Si le problème persiste, communiquez avec le soutien et indiquez votre appareil, votre lecteur, la chaîne et l’heure du problème.
L’IPTV est-il légal au Canada? L’IPTV est une technologie de diffusion, et la technologie elle-même n’est pas en cause. Ce qui compte, c’est que le contenu que vous regardez soit autorisé là où vous habitez. Les règles varient selon les pays et changent avec le temps; vérifiez donc ce qui s’applique à vous. Les spectateurs doivent s’assurer que leur utilisation du service respecte les lois qui s’appliquent à eux. Il ne s’agit pas d’un avis juridique.
Prêt à essayer Prime IPTV au Canada?
Commencez l’essai gratuit de 24 heures, sans carte de crédit, et voyez les chaînes et la qualité d’image sur votre propre téléviseur.

Le forfait de 24 mois représente-t-il un gros paiement initial? C’est le paiement initial le plus élevé; c’est pourquoi nous suggérons d’essayer d’abord l’essai gratuit. La garantie de remboursement de 7 jours s’applique aux abonnements.
Que comprend chaque forfait Prime IPTV? Chaque forfait comprend plus de 25 000 chaînes en direct (toutes les chaînes canadiennes et américaines et des chaînes d’autres pays), plus de 120 000 films et séries, la qualité SD/HD/FHD/4K, l’EPG, le sport et toutes les chaînes PPV en 4K et en FHD, avec un soutien 24/7.
Une garantie de remboursement de 7 jours s’applique, sans contrat. Besoin d’aide pour choisir? Écrivez-nous .

À qui convient ce forfait
Nouveaux abonnés à l’IPTV
Trois mois suffisent pour vous installer, apprendre votre lecteur et voir comment l’IPTV s’intègre à votre façon de regarder, sans engagement long.
Une saison ou un trimestre de visionnement
Il couvre une bonne partie d’une saison sportive ou quelques mois de séries et de films.
Foyers qui testent plusieurs connexions
Vous pouvez essayer 2, 3 ou 4 connexions pendant un trimestre et voir combien d’écrans vous utilisez vraiment.
Bon à savoir
Le forfait de 3 mois a le coût par mois le plus élevé des forfaits publiés. Si vous êtes certain de continuer à regarder, les forfaits de 6, 12 et 24 mois coûtent moins par mois.
Les mois gratuits commencent avec les forfaits de 6 mois; le forfait de 3 mois n’en a donc aucun.
Un exemple concret
Un parcours courant consiste à demander l’essai de 24 heures, à installer votre lecteur, puis à commander un forfait de 3 mois. Si vous restez, vous pouvez passer à un forfait de 6, 12 ou 24 mois pour un coût mensuel plus bas. Pour 1 connexion, 12 mois reviennent à environ 6,67 $ CAD par mois, contre environ 11,66 $ CAD avec le forfait de 3 mois.
Bien utiliser le forfait de 3 mois
Traitez les deux premières semaines comme une période d’adaptation : choisissez votre lecteur, regroupez vos chaînes favorites, vérifiez le guide et testez un événement en direct aux heures de pointe. Nos guides par appareil et la liste de vérification de l’essai gratuit vous accompagnent.
Trois mois sont aussi un bon test d’une relation plus longue. Ils montrent quelles chaînes vous regardez régulièrement et si votre Internet supporte le visionnement du soir, exactement ce qu’il faut savoir pour choisir un forfait plus long.
Le forfait de 3 mois n’a pas de mois gratuit, et c’est la principale raison pour laquelle on passe plus tard à un forfait de 6, 12 ou 24 mois. Si vous savez déjà que vous continuerez à regarder, vous préférerez peut-être commencer plus long.
Comparer avec les autres durées
Comparé au forfait de 6 mois, celui de 3 mois demande moins au départ et un engagement plus court, mais il coûte plus par mois et n’a aucun mois gratuit. Le forfait de 6 mois ajoute +1 mois gratuit et réduit votre coût mensuel.

## Abonnement IPTV Smarters Pro Canada | Prime IPTV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/fr/abonnement-iptv-smarters-pro/

Lecteurs
Abonnement IPTV Smarters Pro : ce qu’il faut et comment l’obtenir
IPTV Smarters Pro est une application de lecture IPTV, et non un fournisseur IPTV; il lui faut donc un abonnement d’un fournisseur avant d’afficher la moindre chaîne. Un abonnement Prime IPTV fonctionne avec IPTV Smarters Pro : vous recevez vos identifiants et les ajoutez avec la connexion Xtream Codes.
Comment fonctionne un abonnement IPTV Smarters Pro
Trois éléments travaillent ensemble, et on les confond souvent.
L’application : IPTV Smarters Pro est le lecteur sur votre appareil. Il affiche les chaînes, les films et le guide des programmes, mais n’a aucune chaîne en propre.
L’abonnement : le service IPTV qui fournit les chaînes et la vidéothèque. C’est ce qu’offre Prime IPTV.
Votre identifiant : les renseignements qui relient l’application à l’abonnement.
Nous expliquons cette différence plus en détail dans service IPTV ou lecteur IPTV .
Ce que vous recevez avec votre abonnement Prime IPTV
Quand vous commencez l’ essai gratuit ou vous abonnez, nous vous envoyons vos identifiants par WhatsApp ou par courriel. Il s’agit normalement d’une URL de serveur, d’un nom d’utilisateur et d’un mot de passe pour la connexion Xtream Codes. Pour un forfait payé, l’activation se fait normalement en quelques minutes après le paiement.
Comment ajouter Prime IPTV à IPTV Smarters Pro
Installez IPTV Smarters Pro sur votre appareil (voir la section suivante).
Ouvrez l’application et choisissez Add New User , puis Login with Xtream Codes API .
Saisissez le nom de votre choix, puis votre nom d’utilisateur, mot de passe et URL de serveur exactement comme nous les avons envoyés. Copiez et collez pour éviter les fautes de frappe et les espaces à la fin.
Touchez Add User et attendez le chargement de vos chaînes, films et séries.
Ouvrez Live TV , Movies ou Series et commencez à regarder.
Où utiliser IPTV Smarters Pro
IPTV Smarters Pro fonctionne sur les appareils Fire TV, les téléphones, tablettes et Android TV, l’iPhone et l’iPad, ainsi que sur certains téléviseurs intelligents et ordinateurs. La disponibilité et le mode d’installation varient selon l’appareil. Pour la Firestick, suivez notre guide d’installation pas à pas pour Firestick . Pour les autres appareils, voyez les guides d’installation .
Prix d’un abonnement IPTV Smarters Pro
L’application et votre abonnement sont distincts, et c’est l’abonnement que vous payez. Voici les prix de Prime IPTV pour 1 connexion. Chaque forfait comprend plus de 25 000 chaînes en direct, plus de 120 000 films et séries, le 4K et le sport.
Durée Prix (1 connexion) Par mois
3 mois 34,99 $ CAD 11,66 $ CAD
6 mois
+1 mois gratuit 49,99 $ CAD 8,33 $ CAD
12 mois
+1 mois gratuit 79,99 $ CAD 6,67 $ CAD
24 mois
+2 mois gratuits 124,99 $ CAD 5,21 $ CAD
Les forfaits de 2, 3 et 4 connexions se trouvent sur la page des tarifs , où chaque forfait a un bouton « Acheter maintenant » qui ouvre WhatsApp avec votre forfait dans le message.
Autres lecteurs compatibles avec Prime IPTV
Prime IPTV fonctionne avec tous les lecteurs qui acceptent les codes Xtream ou un lien M3U , y compris TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV et NET IPTV. Des lecteurs comme IBO Player, Set IPTV et NET IPTV chargent la liste de lecture par l’adresse MAC de votre appareil. Envoyez-nous cette adresse MAC sur WhatsApp et nous vous aiderons à la configurer. Comparez-les dans notre comparaison des lecteurs IPTV .
Questions fréquentes
IPTV Smarters Pro comprend-il un abonnement? Non. IPTV Smarters Pro est une application de lecture et n’a aucune chaîne en propre. Vous ajoutez un abonnement d’un fournisseur IPTV, comme Prime IPTV, pour regarder.
Prime IPTV fonctionne-t-il avec IPTV Smarters Pro? Oui. Prime IPTV fonctionne avec IPTV Smarters Pro grâce à la connexion Xtream Codes : URL du serveur, nom d’utilisateur et mot de passe.
Où obtenir mon identifiant IPTV Smarters Pro? Auprès de votre fournisseur IPTV. Pour Prime IPTV, nous envoyons vos identifiants par WhatsApp ou par courriel quand vous commencez l’essai gratuit ou vous abonnez.
IPTV Smarters Pro est-il gratuit? L’application s’installe depuis une boutique d’applications ou le site officiel, et ses chaînes viennent de votre abonnement. Consultez la fiche actuelle de l’application pour ses conditions. L’abonnement Prime IPTV est distinct et commence à 34,99 $ CAD pour 3 mois.
Puis-je essayer un abonnement avant de payer? Oui. Prime IPTV offre un essai gratuit de 24 heures sans carte de crédit, et nous envoyons les détails par WhatsApp ou par courriel.
Et si je ne veux pas utiliser IPTV Smarters Pro? Prime IPTV fonctionne avec tous les lecteurs qui acceptent les codes Xtream ou un lien M3U, y compris TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV et NET IPTV.
Obtenez un identifiant pour IPTV Smarters Pro
Commencez l’essai gratuit de 24 heures sans carte de crédit, puis ajoutez l’identifiant à IPTV Smarters Pro en quelques minutes.

## Avertissement | Prime IPTV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/fr/avertissement/

Légal
Avertissement
Responsabilité du spectateur
Les utilisateurs doivent s’assurer que leur utilisation du service respecte les lois et règlements qui s’appliquent à eux, y compris les règles sur le droit d’auteur et la radiodiffusion au Canada et dans tout autre pays où ils regardent.
Aucun conseil juridique
Les renseignements de ce site, y compris nos guides sur la légalité et la sécurité, sont de l’information générale seulement. Ils ne constituent pas un avis juridique. Si vous avez besoin d’une certitude pour votre situation, consultez un avocat.
Applications tierces et marques de commerce
Prime IPTV est un service d’abonnement IPTV. Il ne fabrique ni ne possède les applications de lecture utilisées pour le regarder, comme IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV ou NET IPTV. Les noms d’applications, d’appareils et de marques appartiennent à leurs propriétaires et servent uniquement à décrire la compatibilité. Nous ne sommes ni affiliés à eux ni approuvés par eux.
Disponibilité et qualité du service
La qualité de diffusion dépend de votre connexion Internet, de votre appareil et de votre application de lecture. L’offre de chaînes, les événements et les titres sur demande peuvent changer. Des fonctions comme le rattrapage dépendent du lecteur que vous utilisez. Utilisez l’essai gratuit pour confirmer que le service vous convient avant d’acheter.
Prix et offres
Les prix et les forfaits sont affichés sur la page des tarifs et peuvent changer. Le prix indiqué dans votre message de commande WhatsApp est le prix que vous payez.
Questions
Lisez nos conditions , notre politique de confidentialité et notre politique de remboursement , ou écrivez-nous .

## Les meilleurs lecteurs IPTV : Firestick, Android TV, Smart TV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/fr/blogue/best-iptv-players/

Retour au blogue Guide IPTV
Les meilleurs lecteurs IPTV : Firestick, Android TV, Smart TV
Publié le 5 octobre 2026 · Par l’équipe Prime IPTV · 6 min de lecture
La meilleure application IPTV est celle qui convient à votre appareil. Un abonnement IPTV vous donne des identifiants, mais il vous faut quand même une application de lecture pour les utiliser. Le bon lecteur dépend surtout de votre appareil. Si vous ne connaissez pas encore la différence, commencez par service IPTV ou lecteur IPTV .
Comparaison rapide
Lecteur Appareils typiques Méthodes de connexion À savoir
TiviMate Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV Xtream Codes, M3U Populaire pour la présentation de son EPG et le regroupement des chaînes. Certaines fonctions sont payantes.
IPTV Smarters Pro Android, iOS, Fire TV et certains téléviseurs intelligents Xtream Codes (et listes de lecture dans certaines versions) Sections distinctes pour la télé en direct, les films et les séries; rapide à configurer.
GSE Smart IPTV iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Android M3U, Xtream Codes Un choix courant sur les appareils Apple, où les options sont moins nombreuses.
Smart IPTV Téléviseurs intelligents Samsung et LG Liste de lecture M3U Liée à l’adresse MAC de votre téléviseur. Vérifiez les conditions actuelles de l’application avant de commencer.
IBO Player Téléviseurs intelligents et autres appareils Adresse MAC, puis liste de lecture (Xtream Codes ou M3U) Charge la liste de lecture selon l’adresse MAC de votre appareil. Envoyez-nous l’adresse MAC sur WhatsApp et nous vous aiderons à la configurer.
Set IPTV Téléviseurs intelligents et autres appareils Adresse MAC, puis liste de lecture (Xtream Codes ou M3U) Même approche par adresse MAC qu’IBO Player.
NET IPTV Téléviseurs intelligents et autres appareils Adresse MAC, puis liste de lecture (Xtream Codes ou M3U) Même approche par adresse MAC qu’IBO Player.
VLC Windows, Mac, Android, iOS M3U Un lecteur multimédia général : il lit les flux, mais n’est pas conçu autour d’un guide des programmes ou d’une vidéothèque.
La disponibilité, les fonctions et les prix changent avec le temps; consultez la fiche de chaque application dans sa boutique pour les détails à jour.
Qu’est-ce qui fonctionne avec Prime IPTV?
Prime IPTV fonctionne avec tous les lecteurs qui acceptent les codes Xtream ou un lien M3U , y compris IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV et NET IPTV. Certains lecteurs (IBO Player, Set IPTV, NET IPTV et semblables) chargent la liste de lecture par l’ adresse MAC de votre appareil : écrivez-nous sur WhatsApp avec l’adresse MAC affichée dans l’application et nous vous aiderons à ajouter votre liste. Pour un boîtier MAG, envoyez-nous son adresse MAC; nous activons votre abonnement et vous envoyons vos liens de portail.
Quel lecteur pour quel appareil?
Firestick / Fire TV : TiviMate ou IPTV Smarters Pro, installés avec l’application Downloader (aucun n’est dans la boutique Amazon). Voyez le guide Firestick .
Android TV / boîtiers Google TV : TiviMate ou IPTV Smarters Pro depuis Google Play. Voyez le guide Android TV .
iPhone, iPad et Apple TV : GSE Smart IPTV ou IPTV Smarters. Voyez le guide Apple TV et le guide pour téléphone .
Téléviseurs intelligents Samsung et LG : IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, Set IPTV, NET IPTV, Smart IPTV ou un autre lecteur offert dans la boutique de votre téléviseur. Voyez le guide du téléviseur intelligent .
Windows et Mac : un lecteur IPTV de bureau ou VLC. Voyez le guide pour ordinateur .
Quoi chercher dans un lecteur
Il accepte votre méthode de connexion. Xtream Codes est la plus répandue; M3U fonctionne presque partout.
Un guide des programmes (EPG) lisible. C’est la plus grande différence entre les lecteurs au quotidien.
Favoris et groupes de chaînes. Avec des milliers de chaînes, pouvoir masquer ce que vous ne regardez jamais est important.
Options de mémoire tampon et de décodeur. Ces réglages aident quand votre connexion ou votre appareil est le facteur limitant. Voyez notre guide de dépannage .
Prise en charge du rattrapage. La possibilité de revoir des émissions passées dépend du lecteur utilisé.
Utiliser Prime IPTV avec ces lecteurs
Vous utilisez IPTV Smarters Pro? Voyez abonnement IPTV Smarters Pro : ce qu’il faut savoir , et pour la lecture en 4K, lisez le guide IPTV 4K . Prime IPTV est un service d’abonnement qui fonctionne avec des lecteurs IPTV compatibles. Une fois que vous avez demandé l’ essai gratuit de 24 heures ou choisi un forfait , vous recevez vos identifiants et les ajoutez au lecteur de votre choix. Les guides d’installation expliquent chaque étape.
Réponses rapides
Dois-je payer pour un lecteur IPTV?
Beaucoup de lecteurs s’installent gratuitement; certains offrent des fonctions ou une activation payantes. Vérifiez les conditions actuelles dans la fiche de chaque application.
Puis-je utiliser plus d’un lecteur?
Oui. Vous pouvez installer des lecteurs différents sur des appareils différents, et plusieurs lecteurs sur un même appareil si vous le voulez. Le nombre de connexions de votre forfait limite quand même le nombre de flux simultanés.
Le lecteur influence-t-il la qualité d’image?
La qualité du flux vient du service et de votre connexion, mais un lecteur doté de bonnes options de décodeur et de mémoire tampon peut rendre la lecture plus fluide sur certains appareils.
Quel lecteur essayer en premier?
Sur Firestick ou Android TV, commencez avec TiviMate ou IPTV Smarters Pro. Sur iPhone, iPad ou Apple TV, commencez avec GSE Smart IPTV ou IPTV Smarters.

## Combien de connexions IPTV? Guide des forfaits 1 à 4
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/fr/blogue/how-many-iptv-connections-do-i-need/

Retour au blogue Guide IPTV
Combien de connexions IPTV? Guide des forfaits 1 à 4
Publié le 5 octobre 2026 · Par l’équipe Prime IPTV · 5 min de lecture
Les forfaits Prime IPTV comprennent 1, 2, 3 ou 4 connexions . Le bon nombre vous fait économiser si vous auriez acheté trop, et vous évite des frustrations si vous auriez acheté trop peu. Besoin de plus de 4? Écrivez-nous sur WhatsApp ou par courriel et nous vous proposerons un forfait pour plus d’appareils. Ce guide explique ce qu’est une connexion et vous aide à choisir.
Qu’est-ce qu’une connexion IPTV?
En IPTV, une connexion correspond normalement à un flux en lecture à la fois sur votre abonnement. Cela concerne le nombre d’écrans qui regardent au même moment , et non le nombre d’appareils sur lesquels vous avez installé le lecteur. Vous pouvez configurer un lecteur sur une Firestick, un téléphone et un portable, mais avec un forfait à 1 connexion, un seul peut diffuser à la fois.
Comment compter vos connexions
Énumérez chaque écran qui pourrait regarder en soirée : salon, chambre, chambre des enfants, téléphone, tablette et ordinateur.
Décidez du plus grand nombre qui fonctionnerait ensemble un soir de pointe. Ce nombre est votre point de départ.
S’il dépasse 4, écrivez-nous pour connaître les options.
N’oubliez pas la limite d’Internet : chaque flux simultané de plus consomme de la bande passante. À titre indicatif, prévoyez environ 10 Mb/s par flux HD et 25 Mb/s par flux 4K. Plusieurs écrans 4K en même temps exigent une connexion rapide; voyez donc les vitesses Internet requises et notre guide sur la mise en mémoire tampon .
Choisisseur rapide
Combien d’écrans pourraient diffuser en même temps?
1 2 3 4 5 ou plus
1 connexion : Un spectateur à la fois
Convient à une personne seule, ou à un foyer où un seul téléviseur, téléphone ou tablette diffuse à la fois.

Convient à un couple ou à deux personnes aux goûts différents, par exemple le téléviseur du salon et un téléphone ou le téléviseur de la chambre en même temps.
Les forfaits Prime IPTV à 2 connexions commencent à 54,99 $ CAD pour 3 mois et vont jusqu’à 199,99 $ CAD pour 24 mois (+2 mois gratuits).
Voir les forfaits à 2 connexions Demander sur WhatsApp
3 connexions : Trois écrans en même temps
Convient à une petite famille où deux ou trois personnes regardent souvent des choses différentes en soirée.
Les forfaits Prime IPTV à 3 connexions commencent à 74,99 $ CAD pour 3 mois et vont jusqu’à 274,99 $ CAD pour 24 mois (+2 mois gratuits).
Voir les forfaits à 3 connexions Demander sur WhatsApp

Convient à un foyer actif avec plusieurs téléviseurs et tablettes, ou à quiconque reçoit souvent et fait fonctionner plusieurs écrans ensemble.

## Comment regarder la télé sans câble au Canada
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/fr/blogue/how-to-watch-tv-without-cable-canada/

Retour au blogue Guide IPTV
Comment regarder la télé sans câble au Canada
Publié le 26 octobre 2026 · Par l’équipe Prime IPTV · 6 min de lecture
Couper le câble au Canada revient à trois choses : une connexion Internet stable, un appareil capable de diffuser et un service à regarder. Voici le chemin simple.
1. Vérifiez votre Internet
Il faut environ 5 Mb/s par écran pour la SD, 10 pour la HD, 15 pour la FHD et 25 ou plus pour le 4K. Additionnez-les pour les écrans qui fonctionnent en même temps. Notre guide des vitesses contient le tableau complet.
2. Choisissez un appareil
Téléviseur intelligent. Installez une application de lecture depuis la boutique du téléviseur.
Firestick ou Fire TV. Une option populaire et peu coûteuse. Voyez le guide Firestick .
Boîtier Android TV, Apple TV ou Roku. Tous ont des guides d’installation .
Téléphone, tablette ou ordinateur. Idéal pour voyager et pour un deuxième écran.
3. Choisissez quoi regarder
Beaucoup de gens combinent quelques applications de diffusion avec un service de télé en direct. Prime IPTV couvre les chaînes en direct, le sport, le PPV et les films et séries sur demande dans un seul abonnement; vous dépendez donc de moins d’applications.
4. Testez avant de vous engager
Commencez l’ essai gratuit de 24 heures , ajoutez l’identifiant à votre lecteur et testez les chaînes que vous regardez le plus. Choisissez un forfait seulement si cela fonctionne sur votre connexion.
Réponses rapides
Me faut-il un décodeur de câble?
Non. Un appareil que vous possédez déjà suffit habituellement.
Le sport en direct fonctionnera-t-il?
Le sport est inclus, et une connexion filaire aide aux heures de pointe. Testez un événement en direct pendant votre essai.
