Qu’est-ce que l’IPTV 4K? Pourquoi Prime IPTV l’emporte Fournisseur IPTV 4K Boîtier IPTV 4K IPTV 4K en direct Prix IPTV 4K L’IPTV 4K est de l’IPTV livré en qualité 4K (Ultra HD). Pour le regarder, il vous faut un téléviseur 4K, un appareil et un lecteur capables de lire du 4K, et une connexion stable d’environ 25 Mb/s ou plus par flux 4K. Prime IPTV diffuse en SD, HD, FHD et 4K lorsque le contenu le permet, et toutes les chaînes PPV sont offertes en 4K et en FHD. Ce guide explique ce qu’il faut pour l’IPTV 4K au Canada et comment obtenir une image fluide.
Qu’est-ce que l’IPTV 4K?
Le 4K, aussi appelé Ultra HD ou UHD, correspond à 3840 &times; 2160 pixels, soit quatre fois les pixels de la Full HD (1920 &times; 1080). Avec l’IPTV, « IPTV 4K » signifie que la chaîne ou le film diffusé est livré à cette résolution. Toutes les chaînes et tous les titres ne sont pas produits en 4K; l’image que vous voyez dépend donc du contenu, mais aussi de votre équipement et de votre connexion.
Ce qu’il faut pour l’IPTV 4K
Exigence À vérifier
Un téléviseur 4K Le téléviseur prend en charge le 4K, et le port HDMI utilisé aussi.
Un appareil compatible 4K Par exemple une Fire TV Stick 4K, une Apple TV 4K, un boîtier Android TV ou Google TV 4K, ou un téléviseur intelligent 4K avec un lecteur compatible.
Un lecteur IPTV compatible Tout lecteur qui accepte les codes Xtream ou un lien M3U, comme IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV ou NET IPTV.
Une vitesse Internet suffisante Environ 25 Mb/s ou plus pour chaque flux 4K.
Une connexion filaire Ethernet est plus stable que le Wi-Fi pour le 4K et le sport en direct.
Un abonnement avec du contenu 4K Prime IPTV comprend le 4K et toutes les chaînes PPV en 4K et en FHD.
Vitesse Internet pour l’IPTV 4K
Qualité Vitesse approximative par écran
SD 5 Mb/s
HD 10 Mb/s
FHD (1080p) 15 Mb/s
4K 25 Mb/s ou plus
Ce sont des valeurs indicatives, non des garanties. Multipliez-les par le nombre d’écrans qui diffusent ensemble : deux écrans 4K demandent donc environ 50 Mb/s avant tout autre usage de votre réseau. Voyez les vitesses Internet requises .

Comment installer l’IPTV 4K
Vérifiez votre téléviseur et votre port HDMI pour la prise en charge du 4K.
Choisissez un appareil compatible 4K (le tableau ci-dessous énumère les options) et branchez-le en Ethernet si possible.
Installez un lecteur compatible en suivant les guides d’installation .
Obtenez votre identifiant. Demandez l’essai gratuit de 24 heures (sans carte de crédit) ou choisissez un forfait .
Ajoutez l’identifiant dans le lecteur et ouvrez une chaîne ou un film offert en 4K.
Confirmez l’image. Si elle saccade, passez en FHD et faites les vérifications ci-dessous.
Si le 4K saccade ou se met en mémoire tampon
Passez à une version FHD de la chaîne. Une image FHD stable vaut mieux qu’un 4K qui saccade.
Utilisez Ethernet plutôt que le Wi-Fi, ou rapprochez-vous du routeur et utilisez la bande de 5 GHz.
Réduisez les autres usages lourds : téléchargements, sauvegardes et autres flux 4K.
Redémarrez le lecteur, l’appareil et le routeur, et mettez à jour l’application de lecture.
Vérifiez que le câble et le port HDMI prennent en charge le 4K.
La liste complète se trouve dans notre guide sur la mise en mémoire tampon et la connexion .

Questions fréquentes
Qu’est-ce que l’IPTV 4K? L’IPTV 4K est de l’IPTV livré en qualité 4K (Ultra HD), soit 3840 × 2160 pixels. Il vous faut un téléviseur 4K, un appareil et un lecteur compatibles 4K, et une connexion stable d’environ 25 Mb/s ou plus par flux.
Prime IPTV offre-t-il le 4K? Oui. Prime IPTV diffuse en SD, HD, FHD et 4K lorsque le contenu le permet, et toutes les chaînes PPV sont offertes en 4K et en FHD.
Quelle vitesse Internet faut-il pour l’IPTV 4K? À titre indicatif, environ 25 Mb/s ou plus par flux 4K. Multipliez par le nombre d’écrans qui diffusent en même temps, et utilisez une connexion filaire si possible.
Me faut-il un boîtier spécial pour l’IPTV 4K? Aucun boîtier Prime IPTV spécial n’est nécessaire. Il vous faut un appareil compatible 4K que vous possédez déjà ou pouvez acheter, comme une Fire TV Stick 4K, une Apple TV 4K ou un boîtier Android TV 4K, avec un lecteur compatible.
Pourquoi mon IPTV 4K se met-il en mémoire tampon? Les causes habituelles sont le Wi-Fi, trop de flux en même temps, un appareil plus ancien ou les réglages du lecteur. Essayez Ethernet, passez en FHD, redémarrez le lecteur et le routeur, et consultez le guide sur la mise en mémoire tampon et la connexion.
Le 4K est-il offert pour le sport et le PPV? Toutes les chaînes PPV sont offertes en 4K et en FHD. Les chaînes sportives sont offertes dans la meilleure qualité que le contenu permet.
Qui est le meilleur fournisseur IPTV 4K au Canada? Prime IPTV est notre choix. Il diffuse en 4K lorsque le contenu le permet, comprend toutes les chaînes PPV en 4K et en FHD, publie ses prix, offre un essai gratuit de 24 heures sans carte et protège chaque forfait par une garantie de remboursement de 7 jours.
Me faut-il un boîtier IPTV 4K? En général, non. Une Fire TV Stick 4K, une Apple TV 4K, un boîtier Android TV ou Google TV 4K, ou un téléviseur intelligent 4K avec un lecteur compatible fonctionne avec Prime IPTV. Les boîtiers MAG sont aussi pris en charge.
Combien coûte l’IPTV 4K au Canada? Les forfaits Prime IPTV comprennent le 4K et commencent à 34,99 $ CAD pour 3 mois avec 1 connexion. Vous choisissez de 1 à 4 connexions et 3, 6, 12 ou 24 mois.
Peut-on regarder le sport en direct en 4K avec l’IPTV? Oui, lorsque le contenu est offert en 4K. Toutes les chaînes PPV de Prime IPTV sont offertes en 4K et en FHD, et les chaînes sportives sont dans la meilleure qualité que le contenu permet. Testez un match en direct pendant l’essai gratuit.

L’IPTV est-il légal au Canada?
L’IPTV est une technologie de diffusion, et la technologie elle-même n’est pas en cause. Ce qui compte, c’est que le contenu que vous regardez soit autorisé là où vous vivez : regarder ou distribuer du contenu protégé sans permission peut être illégal au Canada. Chaque spectateur est responsable de l’usage qu’il fait d’un service. Lisez les conditions d’un fournisseur avant de payer, ainsi que l’IPTV est-il légal au Canada? et l’IPTV est-il sécuritaire? , et voyez notre avertissement . Cette page ne constitue pas un avis juridique.

Comment demander un remboursement

Quoi inclure dans votre demande
Pour accélérer les choses, indiquez le courriel ou le numéro WhatsApp utilisé pour la commande, le forfait acheté (connexions et durée) et la date d’achat. Si vous avez un problème technique plutôt que de vouloir un remboursement, consultez le centre d’aide .

FAQ
Questions des revendeurs
Qu’est-ce qu’un panneau de revendeur IPTV? Un panneau de revendeur IPTV est l’endroit où un revendeur gère les abonnements de ses clients à l’aide de crédits. Avec Prime IPTV, 1 crédit paie un mois de service pour un client; vous achetez donc des crédits en forfait et activez vos propres clients.
Y a-t-il un programme de revendeurs IPTV au Canada? Oui. Le programme de revendeurs Prime IPTV est ouvert aux revendeurs du Canada et du monde entier, avec des forfaits de 120 à 1 200 crédits et un soutien revendeur 24/7.
Comment fonctionnent les crédits? Un crédit paie un mois de service pour un client : 1 mois = 1 crédit, 3 mois = 3 crédits, 6 mois = 6 crédits et 12 mois = 12 crédits.
Ai-je besoin d’expérience technique? Non. Nous vous guidons pour l’installation, et nos guides par appareil couvrent chaque lecteur pris en charge.
Puis-je fixer mes propres prix? Oui. Vous décidez de ce que vous facturez à vos clients.
Puis-je essayer le service d’abord? Oui. Demandez-nous un compte d’essai gratuit pour vérifier la qualité avant d’acheter un forfait.
Quel soutien les revendeurs reçoivent-ils? Les revendeurs reçoivent un soutien 24/7 par WhatsApp et par courriel.

IPTV sport : hockey, UFC et PPV

Pour bien regarder le sport en direct
Utilisez une connexion filaire pour le téléviseur principal si possible.
Prévoyez la vitesse : environ 25 Mb/s ou plus par écran 4K, et 10 Mb/s par écran HD.
Comptez vos écrans : un forfait de 2 à 4 connexions permet de regarder deux matchs en même temps.
Testez à l’avance un événement en direct aux heures de pointe pendant l’ essai gratuit .

## Disponibilité et vitesse Internet requise | Prime IPTV Canada
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/fr/vitesse-internet-iptv/

Disponibilité
Prime IPTV pour les spectateurs au Canada et dans le monde
Prime IPTV dessert d’abord les clients au Canada et est offert dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires. Il est aussi offert dans le monde entier ; les spectateurs à l’extérieur du Canada peuvent donc aussi utiliser le service.
Quelle vitesse Internet faut-il pour l’IPTV et le streaming 4K?
Prime IPTV diffuse sur votre propre connexion Internet; la vitesse et la stabilité comptent donc plus que l’endroit où vous habitez. Le tableau donne un repère approximatif de la vitesse dont chaque flux a besoin, et de ce que cela donne quand deux ou trois écrans regardent en même temps. Ce sont des règles générales, non des garanties. Les besoins réels varient selon votre appareil, votre lecteur et ce qui utilise d’autre votre connexion.
Qualité 1 écran 2 écrans 3 écrans
SD (définition standard) 5 Mb/s 10 Mb/s 15 Mb/s
HD 10 Mb/s 20 Mb/s 30 Mb/s
FHD (Full HD 1080p) 15 Mb/s 30 Mb/s 45 Mb/s
4K (Ultra HD) 25 Mb/s 50 Mb/s 75 Mb/s
Tirer le meilleur de votre connexion
Testez à l’heure où vous regardez. Faites un test de vitesse en soirée sur l’appareil que vous utilisez, et non seulement sur un ordinateur à côté du routeur.
Préférez un câble. Ethernet est plus stable que le Wi-Fi, surtout pour le 4K et le sport en direct.
Comptez vos écrans. Les forfaits couvrent de 1 à 4 connexions. Voyez de combien de connexions vous avez besoin .
Choisissez la bonne qualité. Si votre connexion est limitée, choisissez des chaînes HD ou FHD plutôt que 4K.
Réglez les problèmes étape par étape. Notre liste sur la mise en mémoire tampon et la connexion couvre les causes habituelles.
Comment tester votre vitesse Internet
Connectez l’appareil sur lequel vous regardez, ou un téléphone sur le même Wi-Fi, au réseau que vous utiliserez.
Faites un test de vitesse dans un navigateur ou une application à l’heure où vous regardez normalement. Les soirées sont généralement les plus chargées.
Mettez d’abord en pause les autres usages lourds (téléchargements, sauvegardes infonuagiques, autres flux) pour un résultat propre.
Comparez la vitesse de téléchargement au tableau ci-dessus, multipliée par le nombre d’écrans que vous comptez faire fonctionner ensemble.
Wi-Fi ou Ethernet?
Ethernet donne la connexion la plus stable et est le meilleur choix pour les téléviseurs et les boîtiers de diffusion dotés d’un port, surtout pour le 4K et le sport en direct. Le Wi-Fi fonctionne bien quand le signal est fort, mais la distance, les murs et un réseau encombré réduisent la vitesse réelle. Si vous utilisez le Wi-Fi, restez sur la bande de 5 GHz quand vous le pouvez et gardez l’appareil le plus près possible du routeur. Les appareils Fire TV peuvent utiliser un adaptateur Ethernet.
Combien d’écrans votre connexion supporte-t-elle?
Additionnez la vitesse dont chaque écran a besoin. Par exemple, deux flux 4K (environ 25 Mb/s chacun) plus un flux HD (environ 10 Mb/s) représentent environ 60 Mb/s, et il faut prévoir de la marge pour les autres personnes qui utilisent le réseau. Si votre connexion ne peut pas supporter cela, réduisez la qualité sur certains écrans ou choisissez un forfait avec moins de connexions simultanées. Le choisisseur de connexions vous aide à décider.
Conseils rapides pour le routeur et le réseau
Redémarrez le routeur si les vitesses baissent, et placez-le dans un endroit dégagé et central.
Éloignez l’appareil de diffusion des fours à micro-ondes et des murs épais.
Déconnectez du Wi-Fi les appareils que vous n’utilisez pas.
Si vous utilisez un VPN et constatez de la mise en mémoire tampon, désactivez-le brièvement pour tester.
Regarder de l’extérieur du Canada
Le même service fonctionne pour les spectateurs du monde entier. Votre expérience dépend quand même de votre connexion Internet locale; servez-vous donc du guide de vitesse ci-dessus. Pour de l’aide à choisir un forfait ou à installer dans votre pays, écrivez-nous sur WhatsApp ou joignez le soutien .
Essai gratuit de 24 heures Voir les tarifs Guides d’installation

## IPTV on Firestick: Install IPTV Smarters Pro (Step-by-Step)
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/install-iptv-smarters-pro-firestick/

Firestick
How to Install IPTV Smarters Pro on Firestick
This guide shows IPTV on Firestick with IPTV Smarters Pro. IPTV Smarters Pro is not listed in the Amazon Appstore, so you install it on a Firestick with the free Downloader app. Once it is installed, you add your Prime IPTV login with the Xtream Codes option. This page walks you through every step.
What you need
An Amazon Fire TV Stick (including Fire TV Stick 4K) or Fire TV device connected to the internet.
The free Downloader app from the Amazon Appstore.
The official download link for IPTV Smarters Pro from the app&rsquo;s official website. Only install apps from official sources.
Your Prime IPTV login (server URL, username and password). Request the 24-hour free trial if you do not have one yet.
How to install IPTV Smarters Pro on Firestick
Install Downloader. On the Fire TV home screen choose Find &rarr; Search , search for Downloader and select Get .
Allow Downloader to install apps. Go to Settings &rarr; My Fire TV &rarr; Developer options and switch Install unknown apps (or Apps from Unknown Sources ) on for Downloader. If Developer options is missing, open Settings &rarr; My Fire TV &rarr; About and select your device name seven times. Menu names vary a little by Fire OS version.
Download IPTV Smarters Pro. Open Downloader, enter the official download link for IPTV Smarters Pro and select Go . When the download finishes, choose Install .
Clean up. After installing, delete the installer file when Downloader offers to, to save storage.
Open IPTV Smarters Pro and accept any prompts.
Add your Prime IPTV login in IPTV Smarters Pro
Choose Add New User , then Login with Xtream Codes API .
Enter any name, then your username, password and server URL from your WhatsApp or email message. Use the Fire TV phone app as a keyboard, or copy and paste, to avoid typos.
Select Add User and wait while the channels, movies and series load.
Open Live TV , Movies or Series and start watching.
IPTV Smarters Pro not working on Firestick: fixes
Login fails: re-enter the details carefully, with no leading or trailing spaces and the correct server URL. Use the Xtream Codes login (not M3U) unless we sent you a playlist link.
Channels do not load: check your internet connection, then restart the app and the Firestick.
Buffering: use Ethernet if you can, and see our buffering and login guide .
App crashes or lags: clear the app&rsquo;s cache in the Fire TV application settings, free up storage, or reinstall it.
Downloader will not install it: make sure Install unknown apps is on for Downloader and that you used the official download link.
Best IPTV for Firestick: prefer a different player?
Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link . TiviMate is a popular alternative on Fire TV and is installed the same way. See the full Firestick setup guide or compare apps in the player comparison . New to the difference between the app and the subscription? Read IPTV Smarters Pro subscription: what you need .
Frequently asked questions
Is IPTV Smarters Pro in the Amazon Appstore? No. IPTV Smarters Pro is not listed in the Amazon Appstore. On a Firestick it is installed with the free Downloader app from the player’s official website.
Do I need Downloader to install IPTV Smarters Pro on Firestick? Yes, in the usual method. Install Downloader from the Appstore, allow it to install unknown apps in Developer options, then use it to install the player from the official source.
Which login do I use in IPTV Smarters Pro? Use the Xtream Codes login with the server URL, username and password we send you by WhatsApp or email.
Why is IPTV Smarters Pro not working on my Firestick? Check your login details for typos or extra spaces, check your internet connection, and restart the app and the Firestick. If it still fails, clear the app cache or reinstall it, or contact support.
Does this work on a Fire TV Stick 4K? Yes. The steps are the same on any Fire TV Stick, including the Fire TV Stick 4K, which can play 4K streams on a 4K TV with a stable connection.
Can I test it before I pay? Yes. Prime IPTV has a 24-hour free trial with no credit card, and we send the details by WhatsApp or email, so you can test IPTV Smarters Pro on your Firestick first.
Need a login to add?
Request the 24-hour free trial with no credit card, and get your login by WhatsApp or email.
Start Free Trial View Plans

## IPTV Channels Canada: Canadian, US & World | Prime IPTV

Channels
Prime IPTV Channels: Canadian, US and International TV
Prime IPTV offers 25,000+ live channels, including all Canadian and US channels and channels from other countries. The lineup covers entertainment, news, kids and family, international programming and sports, alongside a library of 120,000+ movies and series. All PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD.
What types of channels are included?
Canadian channels: all Canadian channels, including sports channels.
Canadian channels: Canadian channels, including Canadian sports.
Channels from other countries: programming from different regions, for viewers who want TV from home or from around the world.
Sports: Canadian and US sports, and sports from other countries across all major sports packages. See sports and PPV in 4K and FHD .
PPV channels: all PPV channels, available in 4K and FHD.
Entertainment, news and kids & family: everyday channels for the whole household.
Movies and series on demand: 120,000+ titles in the VOD library.
Canadian channels
Prime IPTV includes all Canadian channels, so you get the television you would expect from a Canadian package, including entertainment, news, kids and family, and sports, in one subscription instead of several. Quality ranges from SD to 4K depending on the channel.
Canadian channels, Canadian sports and a Canadian IPTV subscription
Canadian channels are included, along with Canadian sports. If you are looking for a Canadian IPTV subscription, Prime IPTV is available worldwide, including Canada. That helps viewers in Canada who follow Canadian teams and broadcasts, and it means viewers in Canada can use it too.
Channels from other countries
Prime IPTV also includes channels from other countries. That suits anyone who wants programming from another region alongside Canadian and US TV, without paying for a separate subscription for each. Your picture quality still depends on your own internet connection, so check the internet speed requirements .
Picture quality: SD, HD, FHD and 4K
Channels are available in SD, HD, FHD and 4K where the content supports it, and all PPV channels are in 4K and FHD. As a rough guide, one stream needs about 5 Mbps for SD, 10 Mbps for HD, 15 Mbps for FHD and 25 Mbps or more for 4K. Use a wired connection for 4K where you can.
How to find the channels you want
Browse by category in your player, for example sports, news, kids or a country&rsquo;s group.
Use the TV guide (EPG) to see what is on now and next across channels.
Use search in your player to jump straight to a channel name.
Mark favourites so the channels you watch most are always at the top.
Not sure which player to use? See the player comparison and the device setup guides . Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link.
Check your must-have channels before you buy
The surest way to confirm a specific channel is to look for it yourself. Request the 24-hour free trial and use our trial checklist , or message us on WhatsApp and ask about a particular channel.
Frequently asked questions
Is there an IPTV channels list? We do not publish a channel list because lineups change. Request the free 24-hour trial and your player loads the full channel list and categories, so you can check the channels you want before you pay.

## Prime IPTV Availability & Internet Speed Requirements
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/iptv-internet-speed-requirements/

Availability
Prime IPTV for Viewers in Canada and Worldwide
Prime IPTV serves customers in Canada first and is available across all provinces and territories. It is also available worldwide , so viewers outside Canada can use the service too.
All provinces and territories · Also available worldwide
What internet speed do you need for IPTV and 4K streaming?
The internet speed for streaming IPTV depends on the picture quality and the number of screens. Prime IPTV streams over your own internet connection, so speed and stability matter more than where you live. The table shows a rough guide to the speed each stream needs, and what that adds up to when two or three screens watch at once. These are rules of thumb, not guarantees. Real needs vary with your device, player and what else is using your connection.
Quality 1 screen 2 screens 3 screens
SD (standard definition) 5 Mbps 10 Mbps 15 Mbps
HD 10 Mbps 20 Mbps 30 Mbps
FHD (Full HD 1080p) 15 Mbps 30 Mbps 45 Mbps
4K (Ultra HD) 25 Mbps 50 Mbps 75 Mbps
Get the most out of your connection
Test at the time you watch. Run a speed test in the evening on the device you use, not just on a computer next to the router.
Prefer a cable. Ethernet is steadier than Wi-Fi, especially for 4K and live sports.
Count your screens. Plans cover 1 to 4 connections. See how many connections you need .
Pick the right quality. If your connection is limited, choose HD or FHD channels instead of 4K.
Fix problems step by step. Our buffering and login checklist covers the usual causes.
How to test your internet speed
Connect the device you actually watch on, or a phone on the same Wi-Fi, to the network you will use.
Run a speed test in a browser or app at the time you normally watch. Evenings are usually the busiest.
Pause other heavy use first (downloads, cloud backups, other streams) for a clean result.
Compare the download speed with the table above, multiplied by the number of screens you plan to run together.
Wi-Fi or Ethernet?
Ethernet gives the steadiest connection and is the best choice for TVs and streaming boxes that have a port, particularly for 4K and live sport. Wi-Fi works well when the signal is strong, but distance, walls and a crowded network reduce real-world speed. If you use Wi-Fi, stay on the 5 GHz band where you can and keep the device as close to the router as practical. Fire TV devices can use an Ethernet adapter.
How many screens can your connection handle?
Add up the speed each screen needs. For example, two 4K streams (about 25 Mbps each) plus one HD stream (about 10 Mbps) is roughly 60 Mbps, and you should leave headroom for other people using the network. If your connection cannot carry that, lower the quality on some screens or choose a plan with fewer simultaneous connections. The connection chooser helps you decide.
Quick router and network tips
Restart the router if speeds drop, and place it in an open, central spot.
Move the streaming device away from microwaves and thick walls.
Disconnect devices you are not using from the Wi-Fi.
If you use a VPN and notice buffering, switch it off briefly to test.
Watching from outside Canada
The same service works for viewers worldwide. Your experience still depends on your local internet connection, so use the speed guide above. For help choosing a plan or setting up in your country, message us on WhatsApp or contact support .
Start 24-Hour Free Trial View Pricing Setup Guides

## IPTV Smarters Pro Subscription Canada | Prime IPTV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/iptv-smarters-pro-subscription/

Players
IPTV Smarters Pro Subscription: What You Need and How to Get It
IPTV Smarters Pro is an IPTV player app, not an IPTV provider, so it needs a subscription from a provider before it shows any channels. A Prime IPTV subscription works with IPTV Smarters Pro: you receive your login details and add them using the Xtream Codes login.
How an IPTV Smarters Pro subscription works
Three things work together, and people often mix them up.
The app: IPTV Smarters Pro is the player on your device. It displays channels, movies and the TV guide but has no channels of its own.
The subscription: the IPTV service that supplies the channels and on-demand library. This is what Prime IPTV provides.
Your login: the details that connect the app to the subscription.
We explain this difference in more detail in IPTV service vs IPTV player app .
What you receive with your Prime IPTV subscription
When you start the free trial or subscribe, we send you your login details by WhatsApp or email. It is normally a server URL, a username and a password for the Xtream Codes login. For a paid plan, activation is normally within a few minutes after payment.
How to add Prime IPTV to IPTV Smarters Pro
Install IPTV Smarters Pro on your device (see the next section).
Open the app and choose Add New User , then Login with Xtream Codes API .
Enter any name you like, then your username, password and server URL exactly as we sent them. Copy and paste to avoid typos and trailing spaces.
Tap Add User and wait while your channels, movies and series load.
Open Live TV , Movies or Series and start watching.
Where you can use IPTV Smarters Pro
IPTV Smarters Pro runs on Fire TV devices, Android phones, tablets and Android TV, iPhone and iPad, and on some Smart TVs and computers. Availability and the install method differ by device. For Firestick, follow our step-by-step Firestick installation guide . For other devices see the device setup guides .
IPTV Smarters Pro subscription price
The app and your subscription are separate, and the subscription is what you pay for. These are the Prime IPTV prices for 1 connection. Every plan includes 25,000+ live channels, 120,000+ movies and series, 4K and sports.
Plan length Price (1 connection) Per month

Plans for 2, 3 and 4 connections are on the pricing page , where each plan has a Buy Now! button that opens WhatsApp with your plan in the message.
Other players that work with Prime IPTV
Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link , including TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV. Players such as IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV load the playlist through your device&rsquo;s MAC address. Send us that MAC address on WhatsApp and we will help you set it up. Compare them in our IPTV player comparison .
Frequently asked questions
Does IPTV Smarters Pro include a subscription? No. IPTV Smarters Pro is a player app and has no channels of its own. You add a subscription from an IPTV provider, such as Prime IPTV, to watch.
Does Prime IPTV work with IPTV Smarters Pro? Yes. Prime IPTV works with IPTV Smarters Pro using the Xtream Codes login: server URL, username and password.
Where do I get my IPTV Smarters Pro login? From your IPTV provider. For Prime IPTV, we send your login details by WhatsApp or email when you start the free trial or subscribe.
Is IPTV Smarters Pro free? The app itself is installed from an app store or the official website, and its channels come from your subscription. Check the app’s current listing for its terms. The Prime IPTV subscription is separate and starts at $34.99 CAD for 3 months.
Can I try a subscription before paying? Yes. Prime IPTV has a 24-hour free trial with no credit card, and we send the details by WhatsApp or email.

## IPTV Sports & PPV in 4K and FHD | Prime IPTV

Sports & PPV
Prime IPTV Sports and PPV: Live Games and Events in 4K and FHD
Prime IPTV includes Canadian and US sports, and sports from other countries across all major sports packages, and all PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD. This guide explains what to expect and how to get a smooth picture for live games and big events.
Sports coverage on Prime IPTV
Canadian sports: Canadian sports channels are part of the all-Canadian-channels lineup.
Canadian sports: Canadian sports channels are included.
Sports from other countries: sports channels from other countries are included too.
All major sports packages: the lineup covers the major sports packages.
For the full list of what is included, see our guide to Prime IPTV channels from Canada, the US and other countries .
IPTV with PPV: PPV channels in 4K and FHD
PPV (pay-per-view) channels carry special events, and many people look for an IPTV service with PPV (also searched as "PPV on IPTV"). On Prime IPTV, all PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD , so big events can be watched in high quality on a compatible TV and connection.
How to get a smooth picture for live sport
Live sport is one of the most demanding things you can stream, because everyone watches at the same moment. These steps make the biggest difference.
Quality Approximate speed per screen
SD 5 Mbps
HD 10 Mbps
FHD (1080p) 15 Mbps
4K 25 Mbps or more
These are rough guide values, not guarantees. Multiply them by the number of screens watching at once.
Use Ethernet for your TV or streaming box where possible, especially for 4K.
Choose FHD if 4K stutters. A steadier FHD picture beats a stuttering 4K one.
Keep other heavy use down during the event, such as downloads, cloud backups and extra 4K streams.
Restart the player and router before a big event, and update the player app.
Match connections to screens. If several games run at once, make sure your plan has enough connections. See how many connections you need .
If something stutters, our buffering and login checklist covers the usual causes step by step.
Test live sport during the free trial
Install your player first (see the device guides ).
Request the 24-hour free trial . No credit card is required, and the details come by WhatsApp or email.
Pick a live game at peak time, and watch for picture quality, start-up time and stability across the whole event.
If you plan to watch a PPV event, check that the PPV channel you need plays in 4K or FHD on your TV.
Choose a plan that fits your household
Plans cover 1 to 4 connections, so more than one person can watch a different game at the same time. Compare plans on the pricing page . Each one has a Buy Now! button that opens WhatsApp with your plan already in the message.

Is there IPTV for hockey and Canadian sports? Yes. Prime IPTV includes Canadian sports channels alongside US and international sports. Check the specific games you follow during the 24-hour free trial.
Does Prime IPTV have sports channels? Yes. Prime IPTV includes Canadian and US sports, and sports from other countries across all major sports packages.
Does Prime IPTV include Canadian sports? Yes. Canadian sports are included, alongside US sports and sports from other countries.
Are PPV channels available in 4K? Yes. All PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD.
What internet speed do I need for live sport? As a rough guide, about 15 Mbps per screen for FHD and 25 Mbps or more for 4K. Multiply that by the number of screens watching at once, and use a wired connection if you can.
Can two people watch different games at the same time? Yes, as long as your plan has enough connections. A connection is one stream playing at a time, and plans cover 1 to 4 connections.
How can I test sports before I buy? Request the 24-hour free trial (no credit card required) and watch a live game at peak time on your own device.

Say you are travelling or staying somewhere for two months and want your usual lineup on the TV there. A 2-month plan matches that period, and you can set it up on the device you already have using our step-by-step guides.
Planning two months of viewing
Two months suits a defined period. Write down what you want to watch in that window, such as a competition, a series you want to finish or the TV you need while you are away, and test those channels first.
If you will use the plan on more than one screen, count the screens before you order. Plans cover 1 to 4 connections, and if two people watch at the same moment you need at least 2 connections.
As the second month approaches its end, review how often you watched and on which devices. That tells you whether to renew for a short period again or to move to a longer plan with a lower monthly cost.

IPTV Toronto questions, answered

Will IPTV work on my condo Wi-Fi? Usually, but shared Wi-Fi can slow down in the evening. A wired connection or a router in the same room as the TV fixes most buffering. Test during peak hours in your free trial.
Can everyone in my household watch at once? Plans cover 1 to 4 connections. A connection is one stream playing at a time, so count the most screens that might play together.

Which Plan
Which Prime IPTV Plan Fits You?
1 connection: one viewer at a time
Right for one person, or a household where only one screen is ever watching. It is the lowest-cost way to get the full lineup.
2 connections: a couple or two rooms
Right when two people watch different things, or the living-room TV and a bedroom or phone run at the same time.
3 connections: a small family
Right when two or three people regularly watch different content in the evening.
4 connections: a busy household
Right for several TVs and tablets, or homes where many screens often run together. More simultaneous streams need more internet speed, so see the speed guide .
Short or long plan?
Start with 3 months if you want the lowest commitment. Choose 6 or 12 months for a lower monthly cost and +1 month free, or 24 months for the lowest monthly cost and +2 months free.

Pricing FAQ
Pricing Questions Answered
Do you offer more than 4 devices? Yes. Standard plans cover 1 to 4 devices (connections). If you need more than 4 devices, message us on WhatsApp or email us and we will quote a plan for you.
How much does Prime IPTV cost? Plans start at $34.99 CAD for 3 months with 1 connection. The price depends on how long the plan runs (3, 6, 12 or 24 months), and on how many connections you need (1 to 4). Need more than 4 devices? Message us on WhatsApp or email us for a custom plan. All prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD).
Which plan has the lowest monthly cost? 24-month plans cost the least per month at every connection count, followed by 12-month and 6-month plans. 3-month plans cost the least up front.
What does +1 month free and +2 months free mean? The 6-month and 12-month plans add 1 extra month at no charge, and the 24-month plans add 2. The free months are added on top of the period you pay for.
What is a connection? A connection is one stream playing at a time. With a 2-connection plan, two screens can watch at the same moment.
Do all plans include the same channels and features? Yes. Every plan has 25,000+ live channels, 120,000+ movies and series, SD/HD/FHD/4K quality, EPG, sports and PPV, and 24/7 support. Plans differ only in the number of connections and the plan length.
How do I order? Press Buy Now! on the plan you want. WhatsApp opens with your plan and price already in the message, and we send you the payment details. You pay by credit or debit card.
How quickly do I get my login after paying? Activation is normally within a few minutes after payment, and we send your login details by email or WhatsApp.
Can I try before I buy? Yes. The 24-hour free trial does not need a credit card.
Is there a contract? No. There is no contract, and cancellation is available.
Is there a refund? Yes. Subscriptions come with a 7-day money-back guarantee. The refund policy explains how to request one.
What if I need more than 4 connections? Message us on WhatsApp or send an email and we will suggest the best option.

## Prime IPTV Setup Guide: Supported Devices & Installation
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/

Setup Guide
Works With Your Favorite Devices
Prime IPTV works with a wide range of compatible devices and IPTV players. Choose your device below for its own step-by-step setup guide.
Firestick / Fire TV
Install IPTV Smarters Pro or TiviMate with the Downloader app, then add your Prime IPTV login.
View setup guide →
Smart TV
Use IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, Set IPTV, NET IPTV or any player that accepts Xtream Codes or M3U.
View setup guide →
Android TV
Install TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro from Google Play on Android TV boxes.
View setup guide →
Apple TV
Use IPTV Smarters or GSE Smart IPTV from the Apple TV App Store.
View setup guide →
Roku
Roku options are limited, so screen mirroring or a Fire TV or Android TV box is recommended.
View setup guide →
Smartphone
Watch on iPhone and Android with IPTV Smarters Pro.
View setup guide →
Tablet
iPad and Android tablet setup with IPTV Smarters Pro or GSE Smart IPTV.
View setup guide →
Computer (Windows / Mac)
Use VLC, IPTV Smarters Pro for desktop, or another desktop IPTV player.
View setup guide →
MAG Box
Send us your MAC address on WhatsApp and we activate your box and send your portal links.
View setup guide →
How setup works on every device
Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link, including IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate, IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV. Setup follows the same three steps on every device. Only the app store and the login screen change.
Get your login. Request the 24-hour free trial or choose a plan . Your login details arrive by WhatsApp or email.
Install a player. Find a compatible IPTV player in your device's app store. Our player comparison shows which suits each device.
Add the login. Enter it in the player, wait for the channel list to load, and start watching.
Which login type will I use?
Xtream Codes: a server URL, username and password. Most players support it, including IPTV Smarters Pro and TiviMate.
M3U playlist: a playlist link or file. Some players use it, and so does VLC on a computer.
MAC address: used by MAG boxes and by MAC-address players such as IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV. Message us on WhatsApp with your MAC address. For a MAG box we activate it and send your portal links, and for the players we help you add your playlist.
New to IPTV? Read IPTV service vs IPTV player app first. On Firestick? See how to install IPTV Smarters Pro on Firestick .
Which device and player should you use?
Device Recommended players Guide
Firestick / Fire TV TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro Set up on Firestick / Fire TV
Smart TV IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, Set IPTV, NET IPTV, Smart IPTV, GSE Smart IPTV Set up on Smart TV
Android TV TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro Set up on Android TV
Apple TV IPTV Smarters, GSE Smart IPTV Set up on Apple TV
Roku Screen mirroring, Compatible Roku IPTV channels Set up on Roku
Smartphone IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV Set up on Smartphone
Tablet IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV Set up on Tablet
Computer (Windows / Mac) VLC Media Player, IPTV Smarters Pro (desktop) Set up on Computer (Windows / Mac)
MAG Box Built-in MAG portal Set up on MAG Box
Not sure about a player? Read our player comparison . If something does not work, see the troubleshooting checklist .
Before You Start
After payment (or when your free trial is approved) you receive your Server URL, Username and Password by email or WhatsApp, usually within a few minutes. Every guide below uses those same details.

## IPTV on Android TV: Setup Guide for Prime IPTV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/android-tv/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Set Up IPTV on Android TV
Android TV, Google TV and Android set-top boxes (NVIDIA Shield, Chromecast with Google TV, Xiaomi, etc.) run the full range of IPTV players from Google Play.
Recommended players: TiviMate IPTV Smarters Pro
What you need
An Android TV or Google TV device connected to the internet, such as a set-top box, an NVIDIA Shield or a Chromecast with Google TV.
Your Prime IPTV login details from WhatsApp or email.
TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro from Google Play.
Ethernet is recommended for 4K.
Step-by-step
Open the Google Play Store on your Android TV or box.
Search for and install TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro .
Open the app and tap Add Playlist / Add New User .
Select Xtream Codes and enter your Server URL, Username and Password .
Tap Next / Add User to load your Prime IPTV subscription.
Common issues on Android TV
The player is missing from Google Play on my box.
Check that the box is Google-certified and fully updated. Some uncertified Android boxes have limited Play Store access.
The TV guide (EPG) is empty.
Add or refresh the EPG in the player’s settings and allow a few minutes for it to download.
Playback stutters after a while.
Update the player, clear its cache and try switching hardware decoding on or off in the settings.
The login works but categories are empty.
Re-add the login, make sure the server URL has no spaces, and restart the app.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Tips
TiviMate offers the cleanest EPG layout and channel grouping on Android TV.
Enable the player’s EPG update option so the TV guide stays current.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on Android TV.

## IPTV on Apple TV: Setup Guide for Prime IPTV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/apple-tv/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Set Up IPTV on Apple TV
Apple TV supports IPTV through players available in the tvOS App Store. Setup uses the same Server URL, Username and Password you receive after activation.
Recommended players: IPTV Smarters GSE Smart IPTV
What you need
An Apple TV HD or Apple TV 4K running a recent tvOS version, connected to the internet.
Your Prime IPTV login details from WhatsApp or email.
IPTV Smarters or GSE Smart IPTV from the Apple TV App Store. Availability can change, so check the store listing.
An Apple TV 4K and a 4K TV if you want 4K picture.
Step-by-step
Open the App Store on your Apple TV.
Search for IPTV Smarters or GSE Smart IPTV and download it.
Open the app and go to Remote Playlists → Add New (or the Xtream Codes login screen).
Choose Xtream Codes and enter your Server URL, Username and Password .
Save the playlist and wait for the channel list to load.
Common issues on Apple TV
Entering credentials with the Siri Remote is slow.
When Apple TV offers it, use your iPhone or iPad as the keyboard to type the details.
I cannot find the player in the App Store.
Search the full app name and check that your tvOS version is current and that the app is offered in your App Store region.
The stream pauses on Wi-Fi.
Use Ethernet on models that have an Ethernet port, or move the Apple TV closer to your router.
The channel list does not refresh.
Remove the playlist, add the login again and restart the app.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Tips
Typing long URLs is easier with the Apple TV Remote app on your iPhone as a keyboard.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on Apple TV.

## IPTV on PC & Mac: Windows and Mac Setup Guide
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/computer/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Watch IPTV on PC and Mac
On a Windows PC or Mac you can use a desktop IPTV player or a general media player such as VLC to open your Prime IPTV playlist.
Recommended players: VLC Media Player IPTV Smarters Pro (desktop)
What you need
A Windows PC or Mac connected to the internet.
VLC Media Player (free) or a desktop IPTV player.
Your M3U playlist link for VLC (ask support if you only received Xtream Codes details), or the Xtream login for a desktop IPTV player.
A wired connection if possible.
Step-by-step
Download a desktop IPTV player such as IPTV Smarters Pro (Windows/Mac) or install VLC Media Player .
In an IPTV player: choose Add User → Login with Xtream Codes API and enter your Server URL, Username and Password .
In VLC: open Media → Open Network Stream and paste the M3U playlist URL provided with your activation.
Wait for the channel list to load, then pick a channel to start watching.
Common issues on Computer (Windows / Mac)
VLC shows a long list with no TV guide.
VLC plays streams but is not built around a TV guide or categories. Use a desktop IPTV player if you want EPG and an on-demand library.
The playlist will not load.
Copy the whole link again and make sure it has no extra spaces or missing characters.
Playback stutters.
Close heavy apps and browser tabs, use Ethernet and update VLC or your player.
There is no sound or no picture.
Check the output device and try a different video output or decoder in the player settings.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Tips
Ask support for an M3U link if you want to use VLC or another playlist-based player.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on Computer (Windows / Mac).

## IPTV on Firestick: Setup Guide for Prime IPTV (2026)
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/firestick/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Set Up IPTV on Firestick (Fire TV Stick)
IPTV Firestick setups are one of the most popular ways to watch. Amazon Fire TV Stick and Fire TV devices are one of the most popular ways to watch Prime IPTV. IPTV Smarters Pro and TiviMate are not listed in the Amazon Appstore, so you install them with the free Downloader app. The steps below walk you through it.
Recommended players: TiviMate IPTV Smarters Pro
What you need
An Amazon Fire TV Stick or Fire TV device connected to your TV and to the internet.
Your Prime IPTV login details (server URL, username and password) from your WhatsApp or email message.
The free Downloader app (from the Amazon Appstore) and a player: TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro, installed from the player’s official website.
A stable connection. An Ethernet adapter is the most reliable option for 4K.
Step-by-step
Install the free Downloader app: on the Fire TV home screen open Find → Search , search for Downloader and select Get .
Allow Downloader to install apps: go to Settings → My Fire TV → Developer options and switch Install unknown apps (or Apps from Unknown Sources ) on for Downloader . If you do not see Developer options, open Settings → My Fire TV → About and select your device name seven times. Menu names vary slightly by Fire OS version.
Open Downloader and enter the official download link for your player ( IPTV Smarters Pro or TiviMate ) from that app’s official website, then download and install it. Delete the installer file afterward to save space. Only install apps from the official source.
Open the player and choose Login with Xtream Codes API (or Add Playlist → Xtream Codes in TiviMate).
Enter the Server URL, Username and Password from your activation email or WhatsApp message, then tap Add User / Next and wait a few seconds while channels and VOD load.
Common issues on Firestick / Fire TV
Typing a long server URL with the remote is slow.
Use the Fire TV app on your phone as a keyboard, or copy the details from your message and paste them where the player allows it.
I cannot find IPTV Smarters Pro or TiviMate in the Amazon Appstore.
That is expected, because neither app is listed there. Install the Downloader app from the Appstore and use it to install your player from its official website, as in the steps above.
Downloader says it cannot install the app.
Check that Install unknown apps (or Apps from Unknown Sources) is switched on for Downloader in Developer options, and that the download link is the player’s official one.
Streams stutter on Wi-Fi.
Use Ethernet if you can. Otherwise, use the HDMI extender if one came with your stick so it is not pressed against the back of the TV.
The device runs out of storage.
Uninstall apps you do not use and clear the player’s cache in the Fire TV application settings.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Which IPTV player should you use on Firestick?
The two most-used players on Fire TV are TiviMate and IPTV Smarters Pro . TiviMate is popular for its TV guide layout and channel grouping; IPTV Smarters Pro is quick to set up and has clear sections for live TV, movies and series. Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link , so you can use either. For a full walk-through of the Smarters option, see how to install IPTV Smarters Pro on Firestick , and to compare more apps read the IPTV player comparison .
Free IPTV on Firestick: try the 24-hour trial
Not sure IPTV will suit your Firestick and connection? Prime IPTV offers a 24-hour free trial with no credit card, delivered by WhatsApp or email. Install your player first, request the trial, and test your channels and a live event at peak time before you choose a plan .
Fire TV Stick 4K and 4K IPTV
Prime IPTV streams in SD, HD, FHD and 4K where the content supports it, and all PPV channels are available in 4K and FHD. A Fire TV Stick 4K on a 4K TV with a stable connection can play 4K streams; for the best result use Ethernet and see what you need for 4K IPTV .
Tips
A wired Ethernet adapter gives the most stable 4K streaming on Fire TV.
If channels fail to load, re-check the Server URL for typos or extra spaces.
If you see buffering, try a lower quality stream in the player settings.
If your login is rejected, contact support on WhatsApp or by email and we will check your credentials.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on Firestick / Fire TV.
WhatsApp Support Get a Free Trial Read the FAQ
Firestick / Fire TV questions answered
How do I install IPTV on a Firestick?
Install the free Downloader app from the Amazon Appstore, use it to install a player such as IPTV Smarters Pro or TiviMate from the player’s official website, then add your Prime IPTV login using Xtream Codes. The steps above walk through it.
What is the best IPTV player for Firestick?
TiviMate and IPTV Smarters Pro are the most used players on Fire TV. Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link, so you can choose the one you prefer.
Can I get free IPTV on a Firestick?
Prime IPTV offers a 24-hour free trial with no credit card, delivered by WhatsApp or email, so you can test IPTV on your Firestick free before choosing a plan.
Why is IPTV not working on my Firestick?
Check that your login details are correct with no extra spaces, restart the player and the Firestick, check your internet speed and try Ethernet. Our buffering and login guide has the full checklist.
Does IPTV work on the Fire TV Stick 4K?
Yes. Prime IPTV streams in SD, HD, FHD and 4K where the content supports it, and a Fire TV Stick 4K can play 4K streams on a 4K TV with a stable connection.

## MAG Box IPTV Setup: Activate Prime IPTV with Your MAC
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/mag/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Set Up IPTV on a MAG Box
MAG box IPTV works by activation: MAG set-top boxes are activated by the box’s MAC address. You contact us on WhatsApp, send us your MAG box MAC address, and we activate your subscription and send you your portal links.
Recommended players: Built-in MAG portal
What you need
A MAG set-top box connected to your TV and your router.
The MAC address printed on the box, which is needed for activation.
The portal links we send you after you message your MAC address to us on WhatsApp.
Ethernet to the router is recommended.
Step-by-step
Find the MAC address on the label on the back or bottom of your MAG box (or in its system information).
Message us on WhatsApp and send us your MAG box MAC address .
We activate your subscription and send you your portal links .
Enter the portal link in your box’s portal settings, save, and reboot the box . Your Prime IPTV lineup loads on startup.
Your MAC address is how we activate your box, so send it exactly as it appears on the label.
Common issues on MAG Box
The portal does not load.
Confirm you sent us the correct MAC address and that the portal link was entered exactly as we sent it, then reboot the box.
I am not sure which MAC address to use.
Use the address on the box’s label or in its system information. A mismatch prevents activation.
There are no channels after rebooting.
Check that the box has internet access and that the portal is saved in the portal settings, then restart again.
The picture looks wrong.
Check the HDMI cable and the video mode in the box settings.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Tips
Keep the box connected to your router by Ethernet for the most reliable streaming.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on MAG Box.

## IPTV on iPhone & Android: Setup Guide for Prime IPTV
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/mobile/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Set Up IPTV on iPhone and Android
Take Prime IPTV anywhere. IPTV Smarters Pro is available for both iPhone and Android and handles live TV, VOD and EPG in a phone-friendly layout.
Recommended players: IPTV Smarters Pro GSE Smart IPTV
What you need
An iPhone or Android phone running a recent operating system.
Your Prime IPTV login details from WhatsApp or email.
IPTV Smarters Pro (or another compatible player) from the App Store or Google Play.
Wi-Fi, or a mobile data plan that can handle video.
Step-by-step
Download IPTV Smarters Pro from the App Store (iPhone) or Google Play (Android).
Open the app and tap Add New User .
Select Login with Xtream Codes API .
Enter your Server URL, Username and Password and tap Add User .
Common issues on Smartphone
Mobile data usage is high.
Video uses a lot of data. Use Wi-Fi when you can and choose a lower quality on mobile data.
The video stops when I leave the app.
Phones can pause apps in the background. Keep the player open, or use its picture-in-picture option if it has one.
The battery drains quickly.
Lower the screen brightness and the stream quality, or use your phone’s power-saving mode.
The login fails.
Copy and paste the details. Phone keyboards can auto-capitalise the first letter or add a trailing space.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Tips
4K streams use a lot of data, so use Wi-Fi when you can.
Rotate your phone to landscape for full-screen viewing.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on Smartphone.

## IPTV on Roku: How to Watch Prime IPTV (Screen Mirroring)
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/roku/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Watch IPTV on Roku
IPTV Roku setups work differently: Roku does not support the same range of IPTV players as Fire TV or Android TV. There are two practical ways to watch Prime IPTV with a Roku in the house.
Recommended players: Screen mirroring Compatible Roku IPTV channels
What you need
A Roku player or Roku TV connected to the internet.
An Android phone, tablet or Windows PC to run an IPTV player and mirror the screen, or a Fire TV or Android TV device as an alternative.
Your Prime IPTV login details from WhatsApp or email.
The Roku and the mirroring device on the same Wi-Fi network.
Step-by-step
Install IPTV Smarters Pro (or another Xtream Codes player) on your Android phone or tablet and log in with your Server URL, Username and Password .
On your Roku, enable Screen Mirroring under Settings → System → Screen mirroring .
On your phone, start screen casting / mirroring and select your Roku device.
Play any channel and it will appear on your TV through the Roku.
For the best picture quality and a full remote-control experience, we recommend a Firestick or Android TV box rather than relying on screen mirroring.
Common issues on Roku
No IPTV player is available on my Roku.
Roku’s selection of IPTV players is limited. Use screen mirroring from a compatible device, or add a Fire TV or Android TV device to the same TV.
Mirroring is laggy.
Mirroring depends on your Wi-Fi. Keep both devices close to the router and on the same network.
I cannot find the screen mirroring option.
Support for mirroring varies by Roku model and software version. Check Settings → System on your Roku.
Audio and video are out of sync.
Restart mirroring and the player. A wired connection for the mirroring device, where possible, can help.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Tips
Mirroring quality depends on your Wi-Fi; keep your phone and Roku on the same network.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on Roku.

## IPTV on Smart TV: Samsung, LG & Android Setup Guide
URL: https://primeiptv4k.ca/setup/smart-tv/

All devices Setup Guide
How to Set Up IPTV on a Smart TV
Most modern Smart TVs can run an IPTV player straight from their app store. The exact player available depends on your TV brand and operating system.
Recommended players: IPTV Smarters Pro IBO Player Set IPTV NET IPTV Smart IPTV GSE Smart IPTV
What you need
A Samsung, LG or other Smart TV with an app store and an internet connection.
Your Prime IPTV login details, or your TV’s MAC address if the app activates by device.
A player from your TV’s app store, for example IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, Set IPTV or NET IPTV, or any player that accepts Xtream Codes or an M3U link. Availability varies by brand, region and model year.
Ethernet, or a strong 5 GHz Wi-Fi signal.
Step-by-step
Open the app store on your TV (Samsung Smart Hub, LG Content Store, etc.).
Search for a compatible player, for example IPTV Smarters Pro , IBO Player , Set IPTV or NET IPTV , and install it.
Launch the app. In IPTV Smarters Pro choose the Xtream Codes or M3U URL login and enter your Server URL, Username and Password .
For MAC-address players such as IBO Player, Set IPTV and NET IPTV, note the MAC address shown in the app and send it to us on WhatsApp. We will help you add your playlist.
Confirm and wait for your channel list and VOD library to load.
Prime IPTV works with all players that accept Xtream Codes or an M3U link. Players that use your TV’s MAC address (IBO Player, Set IPTV, NET IPTV and similar) load the playlist against that address. Send us the MAC address on WhatsApp and we will get you set up.
Common issues on Smart TV
The player I want is not in my TV’s app store.
Smart TV app availability differs by brand and model year. Try another listed player, or connect a Firestick or Android TV box to the same TV.
The app shows a code or MAC address instead of a login form.
Some apps activate by device. Send the code or MAC address shown on screen to our support team and we will help you complete activation.
Channels load slowly or the app feels sluggish.
Smart TV processors are often slower than streaming boxes. Restart the TV and close other apps. If it persists, a dedicated streaming device usually performs better.
4K video stutters.
Check that the TV, the HDMI port and the player all support 4K, and use a wired connection.
Still stuck? See IPTV buffering and login problems: step-by-step fixes .
Tips
Connect the TV by Ethernet if you can. Smart TV Wi-Fi is often the weak link for 4K.
If your TV has no suitable app, a Firestick or Android TV box is a reliable alternative.
Need a hand?
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you set up on Smart TV.
Send your MAC address on WhatsApp Get a Free Trial Read the FAQ
